Month of stress... gone in minutes... from one call.. and a cool folder with goodies!! Plus.. it was THOUSANDS cheaper than I imagined!!!

reviewsSample.author: CJ
reviewsSample.text:
We want to extend our deepest thanks to Steve for his exceptional service. Steve responded to our home on extremely short notice to conduct a complete service on our mother’s septic tank, and his professionalism and kindness made all the difference.
From the moment he arrived, he was courteous, thorough, and incredibly respectful—especially toward our mom. He took the time to explain each step of the process clearly, which gave us peace of mind and showed his dedication to doing the job right.
Jimmy Duncan General Pumping has been serving our community for nearly 50 years, and it’s clear that their commitment to outstanding customer service and genuine relationships continues strong. Steve exemplifies everything we’ve come to appreciate about JDGP: reliability, care, and personal touch.
Thank you, Steve, for your hard work, your compassion, and for taking such great care of our mom. You’ve earned our trust and our gratitude.

reviewsSample.author: Mike Ward
reviewsSample.text: Huge thanks to Steve. Got me out of a major bind at the drop of a hat. Super helpful, polite, and great communication.

reviewsSample.author: Brian Godbey
reviewsSample.text: He was very helpful and very clear explaining our situation he has always been a huge help with any septic tank issues! Even over the phone which you don't see very often! Would definitely recommend him to anyone!

reviewsSample.author: Stone Sauer
reviewsSample.text:
First off, I can't recommend JDGP (Jimmy Duncan Septic Service) enough !!
All calls from Stevie were timely, friendly, very professional & informative to any relative septic issues.
Unsure of my septic location, Stevie stopped by to probe the general area of the tank & located the opening within less than a foot & recommended a reputable & reasonable person to dig the ground if I was unable.
On the day of my service he arrived on time & took immense care concerning the weight of the truck unloaded & loaded towards my property & an older concrete driveway.
Unlike most other septic businesses that may not backflush the tank and only pump & run, Stevie took the time to backflush my 10 year, overdue septic system 3 times to breakdown & remove all remnants from the tank & instructed me on ways to continue to keep the tank & lateral lines working in tip-top shape for years to come.
The business also gave recommendations of individuals who would come & install a septic tank riser & cap to keep from having to disturb the yard & digging up for the future required 3 - 5 year (based on houshold occupants) pumping.
This will definitely be the septic service I will always use & Thank You for reassuring me that there are still owners of businesses today that operate & service like the business of old.

reviewsSample.author: Chad Sweeney
reviewsSample.text: I called and had Steve come out to pump the septic system of lateral lines thy had been installed 6 months ago.  He was real gracious in educating me that it didn’t need it and only the filter needed cleaning.  He didn’t over charge me for the nature of the work that was done.

reviewsSample.text: I couldn’t have been more impressed with a local company, then I was with Hardin County Septic Service. I had a full main back-up that required repeated attempts to clear, plus an extremely bad tank that had not been properly cleaned in nearly 20 years. reviewsSample.author: MAE MAE
reviewsSample.text: Great and professional work! Came out got right to work, any questions I had answered them fully, very informative, quick to diagnose the problem and what he had to do to find the solution.. overall respectable work.

reviewsSample.author: Cole Buttry
reviewsSample.text: Very professional came out to my commercial project and took care of a backed up sanitary system. Got it fixed in 10 minutes where a known name company I called out previously said it couldn’t be unclogged without digging up the line! Highly recommend!!

reviewsSample.author: chris mit
reviewsSample.text: Derrick and his co-worker did an AMAZING job on my mechanical sewer! They were able to come out a day ahead of schedule and had great communication. They took the time to explain the problem and repair options. I will definitely use them again!

reviewsSample.author: Jeremiah Hazi
reviewsSample.text: Dependable plumbing came out quickly and diagnosed the problem. When I called they said the cost for them coming out was 269.00. Also said that the 269.00 would go toward any additional services they may need to provide. The technicians arrived and said I needed to have the septic tank pumped. I asked when they could do it and they said their truck was down. They told me they would call the next day and let me know when they could pump the tank. I waited most of the day then called them back. The guy said his boss was out of town and he would call me on Monday. I didn’t not receive a call back on Monday. I called them back several times with no answer or any further communication. I paid 269.00 for 30 minutes of work and never heard back from them. This is not the way to do business and I will never use their services again. # UN-Dependable plumbing.

reviewsSample.author: Phillip Jackson
reviewsSample.text: This company really helped us out of a bind, my sink was stopped up. One call to Dependable Drain And Plumbing 🪠 and my problem was resolved in record timing. Mr. Vinny and and his co-worker worked us into their schedule in the same day. Thank you all.

reviewsSample.author: Brittney Adams
reviewsSample.text: We are in the process of selling our home and found that our septic and leach field needed to be replaced. We called around to see who serviced our area and could do it quickly within the closing date. During the time we were waiting for a designer to come out, Derek from Maine Septics reached out to check on things. Between how helpful they were with the process, the time constraints we were under and their price compared to other companies we decided to go with them. They were incredible! Very quick, friendly and efficient. Thank you to the team, Chad and Andy especially! We wouldn't have been able to keep our closing date when without you.

reviewsSample.author: Linda Hilts
reviewsSample.text: Want to give complete appreciation for the work done today at my home.  TOM came early this morning for a septic pump out (arrived on tme) in Greene Maine.  Explained when done that I needed a baffle replacement and I requested a new tank cover.  Returned later in the afternoon and. Completed repairs as promised.  Personable, professional and just a really nice guy.  Give him a raise.  Good techs are hard to come by

reviewsSample.author: Carol Severance
reviewsSample.text: I’m so incredibly grateful to Maine Septic & Pumping. My experience with two other companies was a no show, no call & another refusing to come out to my house. They were incredibly knowledgeable, informative, timely & kind. Every person I spoke with was great. They said if they couldn’t help me they would at least help me find a solution. Tommy surveyed the situation, we discussed options & he got it pumped. I really appreciate his patience, experience determination to get the job done. We made a plan going forward. I’m so glad I called them.

reviewsSample.author: Ashley Flaherty
reviewsSample.text: Ive used Maine Septic & Pumping since purchasing my home and they have been nothing short of wonderful. They are prompt, courteous and knowledgeable. Tom didnt know but a well played joke absolutely made what was a very difficult day, a little bit better and I want to thank him for the laugh. I needed it.

reviewsSample.author: Cathie York
reviewsSample.text: I would highly recommend MS&P! We had a serious leach field issue which cause a septic back up into our home. One of the owners, Tom responded to my call within minutes. He scheduled me within 12 hours. He was here when he said he would be.  He clearly explained the issue and drained our two tanks.  He was so pleasant and professional to deal with. We will be customers for life. Thank you!

reviewsSample.text: From one small business owner to another, I couldn’t be happier with the service I got from Tyler and his crew. reviewsSample.author: Kitchen in the Shire
reviewsSample.text:
We had the absolute pleasure of working with Brags Sewer and Septic, and I truly can’t say enough good things. Tyler and his team transformed what used to be an unsightly pit into a gorgeous, sloping lawn complete with beautifully laid fieldstone steps — it honestly looks like something out of a landscaping magazine. From start to finish, they were professional, punctual, incredibly kind, and hard-working. Tyler was open to every new idea we threw his way and always made it clear that his priority was making sure we were happy — and we absolutely are. The project was completed on time, exactly as quoted, and the quality of the work speaks for itself.

What really stood out, though, was the personal care. Tyler kept us in the loop every step of the way, treated our dogs like his own, and made the entire process feel collaborative and stress-free. I’d recommend Brags in a heartbeat, and will call them again for our next project.

If you’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work and treats your home like their own — this is the team to call.

Jimmy was on time, professional and took care of the job in about an hour.   Price was great and he did a great job.  Highly highly recommend this company. I won’t go anywhere else.

reviewsSample.author: Dustin Vance
reviewsSample.text: Quick, friendly, good service and very patient even though our second cap was buried and took a little work to find. Highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Kara Gross
reviewsSample.text: I absolutely love the costumer service and how great Jimmy is to work with. While pumping my septic today, he did a great job explaining some issues and how to resolve them. Would highly recommend! Thank you for being the absolute best!

reviewsSample.author: Laura Holbrook
reviewsSample.text: We simply won’t use anyone else to take care of our septic system. The last time Jimmy came, he told us, given the size of our tank and there were just the two of us, we could wait five years for our next pump out.  We did.  Jimmy came.  He said that there was nothing to pump out and showed my husband.  My husband wanted to pay him for his trip/time.  Jimmy wouldn’t take anything.  That kind of integrity isn’t something you come across often.

reviewsSample.author: Rebecca Watson
reviewsSample.text: We've used Jimmy's Septic since we moved here 7 years ago and they are hands down along to work with!

reviewsSample.text: What a smooth experience! Having a septic system is new to me. I did some research prior and JC Septic was referred to me by my friends. I am glad I had them come out to pump the tank. Everything looked good and we discussed details throughout the process. They were very professional, patient, kind, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend JC Septic to maintain your pump outs/maintenance needs. I will definitely use them again. Thank you, JC!

reviewsSample.author: Kathy Turnell
reviewsSample.text:
Huge shout out to JC Septic! Their response time was incredibly fast, and the crew was outstanding—professional, knowledgeable, and most importantly, honest and straightforward.

They diagnosed and fixed the problem on the first visit, unlike another company that made multiple trips (four), wasted my time, and overcharged me—$1,100 each time they claimed to “fix” the issue—yet never actually resolved it.

JC Septic’s pricing was more than fair, and the quality of their work speaks for itself. I highly recommend them—10/10!

reviewsSample.author: Fred Garrity

Our office manager called at 1702 on Friday Evening they came and were done by 1815 on Friday. Cant say enough good things about the owners of this business. Father Son team working a great business for the Eastern Shore of MD and DE.

reviewsSample.author: Jose Sagastume
reviewsSample.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Pile Septic Services, and I cannot recommend them highly enough! From the moment I called to schedule an appointment, their customer service was exceptional. The staff was friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to help with all my questions.

The technician arrived on time and was incredibly professional. He took the time to explain the entire process and made sure I understood what needed to be done. He completed the job efficiently and left my property clean and tidy.

What impressed me the most was their transparency in pricing—no hidden fees or surprises! They provided a detailed breakdown of the costs upfront, which I really appreciated.

If you’re looking for reliable, trustworthy, and efficient septic services, look no further than Pile Septic Services. They truly go above and beyond for their customers. I will definitely be using them for all my future septic needs! Thank you, Pile Septic Services, for a job well done!

reviewsSample.author: Elizabeth
reviewsSample.text:
I wish I could rate this company higher than 5 stars! We had Pile come out last week to pump our tank and the tech went above and beyond helping us figure out where a clog was as well. He even helped us dig and remove the lid. He was amazing (wish I remembered his name)!

We also used this company 4 years ago after first calling another local company to do our move in pump. The other company lied to us and tried to tell us we'd need an excavator to dig up the lid of our septic saying it was over 3' down (we were buying the house from another state and were not here during this). What the other company was telling us didn't sound correct, so I called Pile for a second opinion. They came out and hand dug it in 5 mins - it was only about 18" down. Appreciate Pile not trying to take advantage of us!

I very highly recommend this company and will be using them as long as we live in the area.

reviewsSample.author: David Lidz
reviewsSample.text: 6 stars out of 5.  Just did a pump out and repair for us.  Great customer service, quick scheduling, show up when they say they're gonna show up, great communication, great technical knowledge, great pricing.  Don't mess with anyone else.  Go with Will and Amanda.

reviewsSample.author: joylee sampson
reviewsSample.text: Very kind and decent people. I called on a Friday and was booked for the following Monday. There was a little misunderstanding over them scheduling for "the week of that Monday" vs the actual day, but they were very kind and I got the tank pumped out on Monday. Reasonable price, very polite driver/operator. Very satisfied with them.

reviewsSample.author: Pamela Rubisch
reviewsSample.text: All we can say is WOW! These guys are professional and literally I had to call them to confirm that they did the service because they returned everything back to the original position and it looked like it had never been touched! We are so impressed by the service and their communication. They made this process absolutely a breeze. Go with Pile for your septic system needs!

reviewsSample.author: Kristin Macedo
reviewsSample.text: What a great company!  Not only were they honest in letting me know that I did not need my septic pumped when I thought that I did.  They were prompt with coming over and performing the work I needed done in order to get my title 5.  Their prices were better then all the other quotes as well.  The attention to detail was great as well as they found a few different issues while performing work and got them fixed and my final price was still below what they gave me as the high end of the quote.  HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

reviewsSample.author: Jeff Johnson
reviewsSample.text: I hired Dan initially to complete a septic test to purchase my in-laws' home. When it failed, I ultimately hired Dan to do the replacement because of the quality of his work on the test, his responsiveness, and professionalism. He did not disappoint. After several delays due to engineering and bad perks, he was able to get started. He worked smoothly with the engineer and health department to get a more economical system approved, saving me money. Mid-way through the project, I asked him for a quote to complete some leveling and drainage in my backyard and again, it was a reasonable price, so he is completing that as well. Dan is the consummate professional and I would recommend him to anyone.

reviewsSample.author: Leanne Keegan
reviewsSample.text: Working with Dan was nothing but a pleasure. I had shopped around and he offered the best price. He was very kind, knowledgeable, and super efficient! I would definitely recommend his services!

reviewsSample.author: Nick Onnembo
reviewsSample.text: Dan and his crew were outstanding.  They gave a fair price, replaced my entire septic system in just 4 days to bring the property to Title 5 compliance, proactively kept the Town Board of Health engaged daily, and was responsive to all questions I had along the way.  I would highly recommend Dan and company to anyone seeking a quality, honest, and thorough excavation or septic project.  If I could give 6 stars instead of 5 I would.

reviewsSample.author: Cheryl Mansfield
reviewsSample.text: Dan did the Title 5 for our septic. He went above and beyond providing information about our system and it’s engineering. Dan is truly brilliant and a person who knows his business & made sure all parties involved knew that no stone was left unturned during our inspection. We have found a company that we will call on again for our future home build and are referring to everyone we speak to. It’s rare to find a company that truly cares enough about their client to spend their off time thinking about their situation and calls them to discuss how to make it right - and then deliver that result. D.P. Mercurio & Sons is top notch and I highly recommend using them.

reviewsSample.author: Grace Thumser
reviewsSample.text: I work for a local plumbing company & called them out of the blue with a huge predicament we ran into. I needed 2 septic tanks pumped ASAP. Wow, did they impress!! They were full, however he kept looking for a solution & found one! This is after I called 9 other companies & was immediately told "no, we're full". I truly cannot express how grateful I am for Nate & his ability to look past the "full" to help out another local company!

reviewsSample.author: Elizabeth Causley
reviewsSample.text:
We are first time home owners and found out our septic needed to be pumped. Rick was able to come out the same day and get it taken care before the holiday weekend. He was also able to get us a new filter when he saw that the one we had was done for. All for a great price!

This was our first experience with Rick’s Septic Services and we will definitely continue to use his services.

reviewsSample.author: Lainy Todd
reviewsSample.text: We called Rick’s to have our septic tank pumped. When they came out they found a few problems. Quoted us a great price and even allowed me to take pictures of the needed parts in case my husband wanted to repair it himself. I was told that if my husband decided to do the repairs and had questions to feel free to reach out. Great guy and great service. Definitely recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Rick Speas
reviewsSample.text:
The guy that owns and operates this business is amazing.

The toilets started backing up late last night (new years eve) in a house we just bought a few months ago.  I started making calls this morning, assuming no one would come out due to the holiday.

Rick's Septic Service answered immediately.  In less then 2 hours the problem was identified and resolved.  He could have charged us anything but his fee was fair and reasonable.  I gave a good tip, but I'm sure it wasn't enough to make up for his lost day off.

We're back to functional again thanks to Rick's Septic Services.

reviewsSample.author: Jason Nichols
reviewsSample.text: Nate was very knowledgeable, and friendly, and got me in quickly! I needed the septic tanks drained and risers added and he made a special effort to complete the job before the rain hit that day. Great guy, fun to talk with –I highly recommend Rick's Septic Tank Services! Thank you, Nate!

reviewsSample.author: Betty Reilly
reviewsSample.text: Kris is a very honest Septic Sewer Inspector who does an inspection based on digging a proper core sample to find out the viability of your Septic System. Kris does not give you an answer based on the age of your Septic System without doing a thorough inspection first.  I highly recommend Kris!

reviewsSample.author: Pete
reviewsSample.text: This company responded within one day to help diagnose and repair our commercial septic system. Others could not do any better than a two week delay.  They also offered advice on how to make the system work better.  Very honest and knowledgeable.

reviewsSample.author: John Maher
reviewsSample.text:
Kris of KT Septic Inspections came out to inspect my septic system on a farm house that was later in the day discovered to have been built in 1837 and remodeled in 1975.  Kris was very professional,  knowledgeable and shared his information very clearly in layman's terms so that you could understand what he discovered.  He if fact discovered several issues with a very old out dated septic system that most likely needed to have the health department come out and do a full perk test of the drain field. He advised the tank needed pump out and discovered it had roots growing into the tanks.  He also advised myself and my Real Estate agent on many other factors related to what needed to be done to up grade the system to full code.

Thank you kris, nice job!!

reviewsSample.author: Sandy Anderson
reviewsSample.text:
My sewer line became clogged after 5:00 pm, yesterday.  Both toilets clogged, bathtub and sinks didn’t drain.
Called AAA-Able Drain Cleaners at 7:30 am in the morning.  It was complicated because I have a newer home without an outlet on the outside of my house to clean the drains with an auger.  They thought it might be a city sewer problem so they called 2 more crews with bigger equipment.  In the end, they removed the toilet to get to the drain with the reel augur.  We heard water running through the drain and they both said, “That’s a good sound”, while watching the video from the camera on the end of the auger.  These guys were amazing.  When they left, everything was cleaned up and you would never know there was a clogged drain.  It took them about 1 1/2 hours.  I highly recommend them.

reviewsSample.author: Karen Howell
reviewsSample.text: They did a fantastic job! I have a 1915 house with a kitchenette upstairs. The sink did not drain. Another company came in and spent a full day with no results. AAA came in and had it working great in 40 minutes. The other company wanted me to pay another $12,000 (after charging me $1700) to replace my plumbing pipes. AAA was fast, reliable, reasonably priced, friendly and had everything working in 40 minutes.

reviewsSample.author: Amanda K
reviewsSample.text: Honestly amazing service and was open and honest with what was going on. They made a few other calls and didn't just leave me hanging. If I need anything again in the future I will be working with them and refer them for sure. Not often I give 5 stars. Yet I apprecaite the two that came to my home.

reviewsSample.author: Andrew D
reviewsSample.text: As a father of 3 kids from age 11 to 6 you can only imagine the amount of cheerios, mac n cheese, and god knows what else has been jammed down my kitchen sink. reviewsSample.text:
Luke with Mathews Septic Service was an absolute pleasure to work with. His pricing was fair, and he took the time to clearly explain every step of the process. I came into this not really knowing what I needed—just that my system needed to be pumped and I wanted to avoid any future issues.

I truly appreciate his professionalism, honesty, and thoroughness. I would confidently recommend Mathews Septic Service to anyone.

reviewsSample.text: Highly recommend. I contacted Blackburn Bros to inquire about septic pumping for routine maintenance on a couple of tanks on my property. reviewsSample.text: We had a small emergency on the 4th of July, one call to Sewer Rooter and they were at our house within an hour. Incredible service…and on a holiday which was even more noteworthy!! If I could rate more than 5 stars I would!!! I wouldn’t recommend anyone else!!

reviewsSample.author: Manuel Tejeda
reviewsSample.text: I had a basement flooding and they were the only ones that came on the same day I called. Every other company was telling me they were a week or 2 before they get to me. Theyre very professional and would definitely recommend them and use them again.

reviewsSample.author: Tyler Fulton
reviewsSample.text: We had Sewer Rooter come to our home to diagnose an issue where we had a little bit of water backing up into our bathtub and laundry hookup when draining from the basement. After explaining the issue pertaining to water backing up when it needed to drain, the tech proceeded to turn on all faucets in the lower level of the home to diagnose the issue. After around 10 minutes of doing this, he flooded our pantry where the laundry hookup is and the upstairs bathroom. Water also seeped into the surrounding rooms and basement bathroom causing damage. The tech did not know what the issue was, which turned out to be a main sewer line clog, and had to have his boss stop by to diagnose this. When we called to discuss the issue, we were told that this was “common practice” when diagnosing an issue and that there was nothing that they could do about it. Because of this, we have had to file an insurance claim for thousands of dollars for the damage and are still trying to get our home back to where it was before letting Sewer Rooter come into it. This was not intentional, but it still happened. The company should have made this right.

reviewsSample.text: This review is long overdue; however it was delayed on purpose.  We had some major drainage issues at the home and had hired Boraczek's Septic & Drain to help address the issue.  Now, when you're doing work like this, it's hard to write a review before you have a good amount time to pass so that you can ensure what was done actually worked.  Well, here I am 2 years later and boy did it work.  From the moment they came to my property, I felt comfortable.  It's a family business and they really made you feel comfortable with the process.  They answered my calls & texts and more importantly showed up on time.  We've been hit with some tremendous rain fall this year and our yard is bone dry and so is our basement.  All downspouts from the gutter lead away from the home and with the amount of crushed stone put in the various trenches they dug, it just works..all of it just works.  Truly thankful to have found their information...just a wonderful experience.

reviewsSample.author: Hillary Smith
reviewsSample.text: Brent was highly responsive, personable, and dependable. After contacting three companies for the repairs I needed—one of which completely stopped responding and others that quoted extremely high prices—Brent stood out right away. He was knowledgeable and took the time to explain everything clearly and in terms I could easily understand. He promptly replaced my septic pump and went above and beyond to make sure the job was completed thoroughly and correctly. I would absolutely hire him again and confidently recommend him to others.

reviewsSample.author: Daniel Thompson
reviewsSample.text: Frozen drain pipe to septic tank... Brent was there within a day with all the ice melting, pipe cleaning, and imaging technology needed to quickly and thoroughly clear the pipe!  Highly professional, knowledgeable, quick, and thorough!  Best quality and value for septic service in NH at a fair price.

reviewsSample.author: Dorothy
reviewsSample.text: Brent from Evergreen responds to calls promptly and courteously. He is conscientious and very knowledgeable in his work and explains issues clearly. I’ve found his pricing reasonable and he makes his best efforts to accommodate in a timely manner.

reviewsSample.author: Paige Abele
reviewsSample.text: I cannot say enough good things about Evergreen Drain and Septic. I had an issue with what I thought was a toilet clog on a Friday night, I contacted two big name plumbing companies one of which never called me back and the other couldn’t see me until two days later. I got in touch with Brent early Saturday morning and he was at my house within two hours. He physically removed the toilet, checked the toilet plumbing and used a camera to actually look inside the plumbing and pipes to figure out what the actual issue was instead of just unclogging the toilet itself. He was able to clear out the pipes, which had roots growing inside of them, and all our toilets and drains are now running like new. My kids were even able to help by flushing the toilet when he asked to help rinse the pipes out, they enjoyed being included! I have nothing but amazing things to say about them. I will never call another plumber as long as they are in business, they have my business forever.

reviewsSample.author: Chris Osgood
reviewsSample.text: Megan and Chris are amazing! I had water backing up and needed my septic tank emptied. From the first contact they responded promptly to my message. They came today and dug out the cover so they could empty the tank. They secured my cover to make it easier to access.  They also discovered my water problem was not the septic but another pipe. They unclogged it so everything is flowing. They went above and beyond a simple tank emptying.  They truely understand that customer service is more then the actual service, it's treating people with kindness and compassion. I highly recommend  them.

reviewsSample.author: Patti Mullin
reviewsSample.text:
When your poop comes up into your shower on a Saturday morning, you’re an old lady living alone, and you are TOTALLY FREAKING OUT, what should you do???

CALL JNV SEPTIC IMMEDIATELY!

Seriously. Just call them.

I got a prompt return call, and that was the beginning of what may be the most ridiculously wonderful customer service experience I’ve ever had — particularly considering it involved sewage.

Forty-five minutes later, the pump truck was in my driveway. ON A SATURDAY.

A gentleman came to my door. I invited him in. He took off his shoes.

Sir, there is POOP IN MY SHOWER and you are worried about my floors. 😂

Then we went outside to “find” my septic tank. Apparently my septic tank had entered the witness protection program. He searched. And searched. He was patient, cheerful, never once acted annoyed — and HE FOUND IT.

He pumped the tank, explained everything he was doing, and kept reassuring this slightly hysterical old lady that everything was going to be okay.

But he wasn’t finished.

He then carried 5-gallon pails of water upstairs and back down to make absolutely sure all my pipes were cleared. He checked everything again. And then — I swear this is true — he apologized for getting some water on my floor.

Again: THERE HAD BEEN POOP IN MY SHOWER.

Then he went back outside, backfilled everything, raked the area, cleaned up, and smiled.

At this point I was ready to hand him my wallet, my firstborn, and possibly put him in my will.

I asked if I could pay him right then.

“No thank you, ma’am. I’ll email you a bill.”

Well, I spent the rest of the day dreading that email. Emergency septic service. Saturday. Forty-five-minute response. Tank hunting. Pumping. Bucket hauling. Plumbing checking. Yard cleanup. Emotional support for a panicking old lady.

I figured the bill was going to require financing.

It arrived Saturday evening.

OMG.

I actually feel like I took advantage of THEM.

JNV Septic: I don’t know how you provide this level of service at that price. The OWNER himself showed up at my house on a Saturday, 45 minutes after my call, and treated my septic emergency as though I were his most important customer.

Patient, kind, thorough, respectful — and apparently completely unwilling to leave until he knew everything was working perfectly.

You somehow managed to turn POOP COMING INTO MY SHOWER into one of the best customer-service experiences I’ve ever had.

Five stars are not enough. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

If I could give you ten, I would.

And with the deepest gratitude and respect, I sincerely hope I never have to see you again. 😂

reviewsSample.text: I can't say enough good things! My husband and I are so thankful for your prompt service, and great prices. Chris got back to us super fast. We are beyond thankful for all his help this week! We found ourselves in a situation and super stressed, Chris eased our minds knowing he was coming as soon as he could. Not many companies like this any more!

reviewsSample.text:

Highly recommended!!

Still waiting for this job to be finished.  Not by this company, but another.  Chris still on this for me.  Appreciate him.

reviewsSample.author: M. Curran
reviewsSample.text: They were able to get us on the schedule VERY quickly (during a heat wave no less) and were very thorough, informative, and professional. The price was also very good. Really can't ask for more!

reviewsSample.author: Joseph Wilson
reviewsSample.text: Stephen at Kent Septic performed a septic system inspection for my wife and I at a home we are in the process of purchasing. Stephen arrived earlier than scheduled to get started and was ready when we arrived to walk us through all the parts of the system, what specifically he was looking for, what repairs he recommended and why, and tips for future maintenance and what to keep an eye on. Stephen was very friendly and had a pleasant and helpful attitude. We were very happy with the service!

reviewsSample.author: Danielle Hebb
reviewsSample.text: Kent Septic performed an inspection for us durning an ice storm! They were very transparent about the possibility of delays due to the weather, and completed the inspection in record time regardless of the weather! We are incredibly impressed and excited to use them for future septic needs!

reviewsSample.author: David Caponigro
reviewsSample.text: Kent’s Septic did a septic inspection at my home. Very pleased with their professionalism, communication skills and overall service. Kept everything quick and simple. Will use again for any septic work.

reviewsSample.author: Rosamund Grene
reviewsSample.text: Kent Septic was incredible. Our inspector was knowledgeable and prompt. They made scheduling SO easy, and our appointment was very useful. The inspector was kind, funny, and very helpful. We are first time home buyers and knew NOTHING about septic systems. Our instructor was very patient and explained our system to us, and gave us pointers for how to take care of the system and maintain it, what to expect, and what to look out for. We learned a lot from working with him, and would definitely recommend this service to anyone looking. We now feel much more confident and comfortable taking care of our "new" septic system. Thank you, Kent Septic!

reviewsSample.author: Sam Knowlton
reviewsSample.text: I was in a very emergency situation with a crushed septic pipe at a fully occupied multi unit. Taylor and his team took my call, reshuffled their day and were onsite within a couple hours, excavator and all!! They were respectful, communicative, funny and professional. They absolutely saved me from a bad situation. Thank you guys!! Highly recommend.

reviewsSample.author: Tim Chu
reviewsSample.text: Taylor and his crew were exceptional!  On a Saturday, our septic system’s transfer pump malfunctioned. Taylor got back to me within an hour, scheduling a crew and ensuring everything was ready and operational by Monday. I can’t express my gratitude enough for their professionalism, the high quality of their work, and their remarkable speed and efficiency. Thank you very much!

reviewsSample.author: Niko Garoufalis
reviewsSample.text: A big "thank you" to Nest & Sons Inc -Tom for a great service! We just had our first time new septic pumped and it was a breeze.  On time, very knowledgeable,  good prices  and most importantly  a family businesses  with 33 years of experience.  Definitely would recommend their services to everyone with septic needs or concerns. See you in 3 years again on our next service.  Niko & Rachel from Biddeford!!!

reviewsSample.author: Yvan Landry
reviewsSample.text: We had a septic issue that was discovered during a home inspection because we were selling our home. The team from Nest and Sons did an awesome job accommodating us into their schedule in order to expedite the closing. They also had to dig the trench by hand due to it being underneath a porch. They did not hesitate and did the job in a very timely manner. Very satisfied with the work they did.

reviewsSample.author: Liz Brown
reviewsSample.text: What a great experience!! My first interaction was with Kathy who answered my call right at 8 am when they opened. She was so very pleasant and professional over the phone. She assured me that someone could come out the same day for our emergency septic back up, and at 9:35 am, Tom arrived! This was much earlier than I anticipated since they were fitting us in to their already busy schedule. Our technician was Tom and was friendly, extremely knowledgeable and got to the root of our problem immediately. He explained how our system worked, showed us that we needed an additional riser on the inlet side of our tank and quickly got to work. Within 30 minutes everything was working as it should and our tank was pumped. Tom was truly fabulous...not all heroes wear capes! I would not hesitate to recommend Nest & Sons and will use them for any and all of our septic needs in the future.

reviewsSample.text: Called over Memorial Day weekend to have our septic pumped. They were so incredibly kind and got us scheduled for that wednesday. reviewsSample.author: Tony Smith
reviewsSample.text: Great service, price was reasonable. I was having some issues with my septic tank that I had "fixed" from a previous septic service which I had used in the past. I called AAA All Drains per a referral from a neighbor to have my system pumped. The driver was very friendly and acknowledged my requests. The guy found a problem with my tank, which he was not informed of prior. When I mentioned how I had it fixed, he proceeded to show  me the crack in my tank and how it was never sealed properly -- I couldn't believe it, I was robbed of my money! Thankfully AAA All Drains referred me to a great repair service that saved me $$$$$ ! I have no more issues with my system and would have never known what was truly wrong without AAA All Drains. Highly recommend them!

reviewsSample.author: Dawn Lasser
reviewsSample.text: We had emergency and the came at 9 pm no questions asked. They are a 24/7 company and have been in business for 20 plus years,.. Very fair prices. Thank you John Jr. we highly recommend your company!!

reviewsSample.author: Dawn Roberts
reviewsSample.text: If I could give this company 10 stars I would! Had a problem with slow drain and gurgling in the pipes..called plumber who took my $$ then gave me nightmare scenarios about the septic being bad. Called this company, spoke to awesome office Mgr Dawn, and she calmed my fears, and put me on the schedule right away. Whenever I needed confirmation & encouragement that all would be handled, I could call Dawn anytime and talk it through..John came out, diagnosed, and fixed the problem immediately..he was very honest in saying I didn't need a new septic. He found the problem and had a solution from his experience in the field.. The integrity and honesty of this company has restored my faith in humanity. This company will always be my Go-To source for any drain or septic issues I may have. Thank you John, Dawn, and the entire team!

reviewsSample.author: Mackenna Fitz
reviewsSample.text: Great customer service on the phone for appointment set up. Kept in touch the morning of our appointment and called right after to talk about info.  Even closed our gate afterwards! Great prices and excellent customer service 👍🏼

reviewsSample.author: Chris Neher
reviewsSample.text: I've been meaning to write this review for a while, now.  Sometimes you just HAVE to review a business!  It is not hyperbole to say that Adam at Corrales Septic saved Christmas!  'Twas the day before Christmas when all through the house.. WASTEWATER starting backing up.  Our daughters and son-in-law were visiting, and suddenly we had a panicked MESS on our hands (and at our feet). We're fairly new to the world of septic systems, so we had no clue what to do.  I started calling around for help, including the service that had installed the septic tank.  The best I could find after several calls was "We could be out on the 27th".  WHAT?  Christmas with a houseful of guests and NO WORKING TOILETS??  No one was helping. Finally, my husband reached Adam at Corrales Septic.  He couldn't come out, either, but what he could do, he said, was to help us figure out a way to get the toilets flushing again.  He gave us something to try, promising us that, should it not work, he would give us more ideas.  He kept his promise, and with the third phone call, we had a winning strategy and my husband felt like a conquering hero!  The toilets could flush!  The sink could drain!  We could clean up the mess and have the kind of Christmas I didn't know was my favorite: the kind with indoor plumbing!  Adam came out a few days later to pump our tank and was prompt, professional, informative and reasonable.   We are customers for life!

reviewsSample.author: Ryan Brooks
reviewsSample.text: Adam was fantastic during the visit. From carefully navigating the big truck on our property, to explaining how everything works, then going above and beyond to answer my many questions, he now has a lifelong customer over here. Thank you!!

reviewsSample.author: April Jaglo
reviewsSample.text: Adam came to pump our septic tank and discovered that the system had been installed incorrectly. He has been incredibly helpful in guiding us through the process of getting it fixed. Adam is honest, ethical, and extremely knowledgeable. We truly can’t recommend him highly enough!

reviewsSample.author: Mary Behne
reviewsSample.text:
Adam showed to our appointment early and shared knowledge on maintenance and long term care. Wonderful to work with and support a family owned and operated business.

Thanks - Ken and Mary

reviewsSample.text:

reviewsSample.author: Lynn Sedgwick
reviewsSample.text: Thanks for quickly sending someone out on a Friday afternoon in the summer, to pump out our 2 tanks. Then on Monday, they were back to replace the pump and floats. We appreciate your timely and professional work.

reviewsSample.author: Ashton Baker
reviewsSample.text: Had a great experience with them. I thought my septic tank was backed up called them for a pump out, the driver informed me I didn't need a pump and wasn't going to do a service that isn't needed. They sent out a service truck and the driver was super helpful he jetted my pipe from the tank back to the house and cleared the clog. Found the pipe to be in need of replacement due to rust. They got me back up and going and the driver gave honest feedback on how I should proceed and things I should do to prevent further issues down the road. Thank you!

reviewsSample.author: Christine Puza
reviewsSample.text: Wish I could give these folks 10 stars...I've used this company twice in inspecting the septic systems of prospective homes I wanted to buy. They actually answer the phone! Scheduling was quick and easy and the people working there were respectful and let me know what was what and their expert opinion on what they assessed as the issues.  The reports were clear and they answered all my questions well and helped me understand how my system works- I really appreciated the time they took to explain it all. It's always wonderful to find people who are good at what they do.  These guys know their stuff and will give you the true lay of the land, quickly and efficiently!

reviewsSample.author: Stephen Dolgin
reviewsSample.text: Maggio and sons were referred as prompt reliable and skilled. They were. The company. Has a strong crew, lots of equipment, experience and know how. They did just what they said they would do. We didn’t want shiny black surface on our old farmhouse.

reviewsSample.author: Anu Mittal
reviewsSample.text: Our experience working with Artie Maggio was a great one. We got a beautiful good sized patio made by them in 3 days He listened to all we wanted and how we wanted . Took care of all the paper work needed to be done to get the construction approved. We are so happy that we decided to work with them. We strongly recommend him for any such quality work.

reviewsSample.author: paul VanDenburgh
reviewsSample.text: As usual Peter & Artie and crew did a very professional job. We like the stone infused topping very much and it tapered right to our deck which is perfect as we can use it if we need to have accessible items like a chair lift!

reviewsSample.author: Dianne Lugo
reviewsSample.text: Maggio and Sons company is a professional, knowledgeable business with a great team/crew of individuals who were prompt, efficient, and took care of all the details.  From the estimate appointment to job completion, they were always on time , were there when they said they would be there, and finished the job quickly and exactly the way I wanted it done.  No complaints, would definitely recommend them.  Peter and Artie were easy to work with and have great customer service skills.

reviewsSample.author: Geoffrey Loviza
reviewsSample.text: Over the winter, my septic system failed.  I contacted Maggio and Sons, and from the beginning they were professional and provided exceptional service.  Steve explained everything that needed to be done, provided me with contact information of several different engineering firms and assisted with the permit process.  They were fully transparent and fair about pricing and when the work began, the quality was top-notch and finished far sooner than I anticipated.  With everything finished they even saved time to offer suggestions and cost estimates on some additional excavation projects I am considering.  I highly recommend Maggio and Sons for any of the many services they provide.

reviewsSample.author: Kyral Symouri
reviewsSample.text: I called and got a real person. The man was friendly and gave me a quick quote for the cost, and even got me in the schedule for the very next morning. I felt the fee was below what I expected, and the man who came to pump was personable and even was kind to my dog's, even if they were a bit nosey to him. Will definitely use them again when it's time. I think the only negative is when filling the hole back in, they didn't get the grass back in properly. But it's a hole, not sure anyone can. Great quality employee, and a fast adorable service. Do recommend

reviewsSample.author: Kelly McDermott
reviewsSample.text: I’m currently in the process of buying a home and needed a septic inspection done. Straights was one of the first places I called and they were able to set up an appointment as soon as possible. I had the pleasure of working with Shawn, he was so amazing during the whole process. There were a few hiccups with the seller of the house paving over the septic tank and Shawn did not charge me for coming out since he wasn’t actually able to do anything. We rescheduled under the impression that the seller had fixed the issue, shocker he didn’t. So Shawn took it in his own hands and said he would cut up the driveway so he could get to the tank it would just cost the seller. He was nothing but professional the entire time and very courteous. I would definitely recommend Straights septic to anyone!

reviewsSample.author: Luanne Castle
reviewsSample.text: Just had the best experience with Straight's Septic Service!  We needed an emergency septic pump out.  They contacted me and told me when I could expect their arrival.  They arrived promptly, were both friendly and professional.  They are fair priced and they know their stuff!  Would highly recommend them to everyone including friends and family.

reviewsSample.author: Tracy Choudhury
reviewsSample.text: My call was answered immediately and they were timely in getting out to our place to pump out the septic tank. Great customer service in every way. They were very friendly and took the time to explain things to us. We recommend this service and will use them again in the future.

reviewsSample.author: Thomas Beauter
reviewsSample.text: Mike has the equipment and knowledge to get it done and done right, after many years of wanting the work that I’ve wanted to get done it’s finally coming to fruition and I could not be happier with the work Mike has done for me, he has done exactly what I wanted, he has made a dream of mine for my property come true, as of the writing of this post he has one more phase to go and have no doubt he will continue on with the same professionalism, exacting excavation, and perfect results as the first three phases of this project for my property, you can’t go wrong and won’t be disappointed by hiring him

reviewsSample.author: David Quam
reviewsSample.text: Working with Tri-County (Mike P.) was a godsend for me and my wife building our dream home in the the Northern Catskills. Mike forestry mulched almost 3 arcres of thicket, installed 300ft driveway, site work prior to foundation, excavated the foundation for Superior Wall system, trenched for under ground power and well conneciton, septic install and final grading. Being from out of state 2 1/2 hours away he provide trusted, excellent work for all of our needs. A good portion of his work is documented on the Dirt Boss youtube channel. Highly recommend Tri-County!

reviewsSample.author: Craig
reviewsSample.text: I have used Tri-County Excavating (Mike Petropol, aka “Dirt Boss” on YouTube) for many jobs - both big and small - for over 10 years now. No matter the task, one thing is for sure, the job will always get done right! There’s no doubt Mike is the most qualified and experienced excavator in the Capital District, able to solve any problem in the most cost effective manner. Whether it’s foundations, septic systems, water lines, concrete slabs, demos or lot clearing, french drains, ponds and streams, boulder retaining walls, driveways, or nearly any other job you can dream up - Mike can do it and do it well, and can even help with planning and design if needed. It’s no wonder many of his customers, like me, go out of their way to use him repeatedly over the years. Check out his YouTube channel to get a taste of what he can do and the quality of his work. A true professional who you can trust. You won’t be disappointed if you hire Mike and Tri-County excavation for your job!

reviewsSample.author: Matt Reamer
reviewsSample.text: Mike was very quick to respond to my inquiry about some work. You did a fantastic job of installing a ribbon drain. When it was not going to function as we originally designed, Mike was quick to come up with an idea to make it work. I think it works better than originally designed. He paid very close attention to small details and made sure that the ground was finish grade when he was complete. Definitely would use him again for any excavating work

reviewsSample.author: Samuel Lee
reviewsSample.text: Great experience. Mike went out of his way to inspect a parcel for me on his own since I live 2.5 hours away, exactly when he said he would. We spoke afterward and he shared thoughtful, insightful feedback. Very responsible and easy to work with - highly recommend.

reviewsSample.text: Couldn't have picked a better company for the job we needed done, not to mention the most reasonable price for everything that needed repair. reviewsSample.author: Rachel Coss
reviewsSample.text: I can’t say enough good things about Dave and his crew! We were told 3 years ago we needed a new leach line at a cost of 10 grand well a lot of people we couldn’t afford that at the time so we were pumping it every year. Thank God our normal company could not come when we needed them, called AAA Suburban and thought I whoever that could come before that weekend! Thank God These guys came! I had told him what the other company told us… he got to looking and we had water dripping from a pipe with no water running in the house. Dave came in checked the tank on the toilets and said I bet these are leaking! Sure enough they were he told us this simple trick to do and we have no more issues! Every thing works great! He showed my husband how to check to make sure the drip stopped and it did!!! Thank You Dave for telling us the problem!!!

reviewsSample.author: Carol Cameron
reviewsSample.text: I can't recommend Meyer Septic enough, six stars if possible!  Meticulous service, very knowledgeable and professional. We needed to move our system to a new location. Lastly, Pete had his kids working with him.  They were awesome, respectful and incredibly hardworking.  It might sound funny, but getting a new septic system installed was probably the most enjoyable home improvement project we've ever done.

reviewsSample.author: Izzy Defino
reviewsSample.text:
John and his crew are terrific! Extremely knowledgeable, patient teachers, and efficient and friendly workers!
As new homeowners we can’t thank them enough. We’re also somewhat new to septic systems and well water so it was great to talk and learn from John. We felt other companies did not care to help us understand our systems and likely wanted us to break them so we’d have to pay more in the future.
I’ve been recommending Truly Green/Sloboda/American Septic to everyone I talk to!

reviewsSample.author: Barry Baloga
reviewsSample.text:
Reviews of Sloboda Brothers led me to use them for my most recent septic cleaning and so glad I took the time to contact them. They are a good, honest company with workers who are pleasant and responsible. John was a pleasure to speak with over the phone and communication regarding appt time was excellent.

They saved over HALF of what other companies wanted to charge me and without all the other nonsense charges these other companies want to tack on to your bill!

Highly recommended.

reviewsSample.author: Brent Robison
reviewsSample.text: John came to consult with us about our septic issue and he was a great help. He explained things thoroughly and was kind and very knowledgeable. He's old school and has practical ideas about good septic health. We really appreciated his time and highly recommend giving them a try.  We look forward to using them in the future.

reviewsSample.author: John Martucci
reviewsSample.text: I called American Septic Service to ask if they would be available to deal with a failing leach field, letting them know that my son was going to try to fix it himself, but I was hoping they'd be on standby if the job was too big for him. I spoke to John, who I believe runs the business.  He took the time to explain to me all the reasons why a septic might overfill, and gave me numerous tips on what to look for and how to fix it. As it turned out, my son was able to fix it after all, but I'm grateful for John's generosity with his time and expertise.  I would recommend this company to anyone who needs any kind of septic system service.

reviewsSample.author: Jaime Sosa
reviewsSample.text: JOHN is an amazing human being who truly understand customer service. I was very impressed with his business approach and how he made sure that we understood our septic tank system. He worked with us and walked us through solving our problem.  His company truly makes you feel that they our not there to take our money. I will continue to have American Septic as our number one septic systems experts

reviewsSample.author: Christy Meadows
reviewsSample.text: My husband and I used Donahue for our septic tank repairs.  Keith and Cowboy were very kind, knowledgeable and honest. We will definitely be recommending them to our family and friends!

reviewsSample.author: Lisa Bisher
reviewsSample.text:
My husband and I knew nothing about our septic system as we moved from an area that had city water and sewer.
We called Donahue Septic Tank Service upon a recommendation.  He was so kind.  He asked qualifying questions over the phone. Then he allowed us to call him to talk us through troubleshooting to help determine our issue.
We found his service Honest and fair.  We sincerely enjoyed working with him and appreciated all of his help with our Septic.  I would highly recommend him to anyone that needs assistance with their septic tank!

reviewsSample.author: Stuart Smith
reviewsSample.text: Very responsive and a man of his word.  I know all these septic repair operators stay busy, but Donahue was one of only a couple of the eight that I called who actually returned my call in a timely manner.  He arrived the same day and after making a quick test and diagnosis, returned the next day with the new pump even before the promised time and had my system up and running again.  The charge was very reasonable -- I was expecting a lot more.

reviewsSample.author: David Schickedantz
reviewsSample.text: Called Keith on a Friday, he walked me through troubleshooting issue over the phone. Once solved, he was out first thing Monday morning for repair of septic lift pump. Super knowledgeable and nice guy. Highly recommend!!

reviewsSample.author: Justin
reviewsSample.text: Mr. Donahue is noting short of heaven sent.  I have used his services twice now and each time he is funny, professional and educational.  He took time out of his day to educate my daughter on how a septic systems works and just spoke with me about septic care during these heavy rains.  I have been stressed out and he really put my mind at ease.  People like Mr. Donahue are true blessings.  I will use his services as long as I own a septic tank.  A+++ service!!

reviewsSample.author: Cynthia Kaminski
reviewsSample.text: Brian’s Septic Service did an outstanding job installing our new septic system. Clear quote, excellent communication, smooth installation, and they even handled the inspection process seamlessly. Professional, efficient, and trustworthy from start to finish—highly recommend.

reviewsSample.author: Stephanie Robertson
reviewsSample.text: Brian and another very nice man (i didnt catch his name) came today and did a pretty extensive repair and fixed issues we had where a company 3 weeks ago  didnt properly assess issue. Hopefully now everything is good amd going with the install of 3 d boxes. He was very explanatory about what he found and what he was doing as he did it. Hopefully ill not need anymore septic services but if I do it will be him and ill refer him every chance I get.

reviewsSample.author: Kirby Graves
reviewsSample.text: Brian’s septic saved our lives! We called them to replace our septic system after we had some back ups. We had family coming into town so we needed to do something quickly. After calling many people who wouldn’t call us back Brian and his team got out to our property to look at the job the next day, gave us a quote and even suggested an upgraded system that we ultimately chose to go with. He had a great rapport with the county inspector which gave me a lot of confidence in his work. It took them only 2 days to complete the job and they even got us connected early so we could take a shower.  I will always suggest to my friend’s family and clients that they work with Brian’s septic because we couldn’t be happier with their work. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.

reviewsSample.author: Susie Hill
reviewsSample.text:
He was on time, did a wonderful job, and was wonderful to work with. He answered all the questions I had and helped me to understand all that I didn't. He was thorough with explaining what he had to fix and why.
I would highly recommend this company to anyone having any plumbing issues.

reviewsSample.author: Josh Bryant
reviewsSample.text: Had a septic issue where I could not use any water in the house. Brian was the only septic service to answer the phone on a Saturday and came right out to help. Him and his helper got me back up and running in no time and let me know of another couple of issues that need to be addressed. Pricing is fair and honest. Would highly recommend Brian’s Septic Service.

When the crew showed up, I was very impressed by their rig - Big Dodge truck with an extra diesel tank to refuel the skid steer with mulching head. The crew was able to clean up more deadfall than I expected, even going down a steep hill behind my home to mulch a 24" diameter tree that was rotting. The finished area looks just like a park now and made it so much easier to get back in the woods to do a bit more cleanup. They did more work in 8 hours than I did in the 3 years we have lived there. The skid steer left no marks on our lawn and the mulch was spread out nicely.

I couldn't have asked for better service!

reviewsSample.author: Christine Lee
reviewsSample.text:
If you're facing any issues with your septic system, look no further than Coastal Septic Solutions—the best in the business! I recently experienced a troubling gargling noise coming from my sinks and toilets, which had me concerned. Thankfully, I reached out to Coastal Septic Solutions, and my anxiety quickly turned into relief.

From my first call, Tracy was incredibly helpful and scheduled Sam to come out the very next morning. Sam arrived on time and immediately made me feel at ease. He took the time to explain how a septic tank functions and the potential implications of the issues I was experiencing. His in-depth understanding and clear communication transformed what could have been a stressful situation into a learning experience.

During his inspection, Sam noted that the pipe connecting my house to the first tank was improperly angled, which was causing the gargling noise. He explained that water pooling over the pipe could lead to significant problems, including potential sewage backup into the home if left untreated. Most homeowners might overlook such signs, but Sam made it clear how critical it was to act quickly.

After Sam’s thorough assessment, I contacted Tracy to discuss the necessary repairs. She echoed Sam's findings and offered a clear plan to fix the issue—chipping away concrete to realign the pipe for better flow. I appreciated their transparency regarding the procedure and the importance of proper execution, given the risks involved with puncturing the tank.

What stood out most to me was how much I learned about my septic system through this process. Coastal Septic Solutions didn't just treat my problem; they empowered me with knowledge about septic maintenance and warning signs to watch for in the future. They truly care about their clients' understanding and satisfaction.

Additionally, I found their pricing to be very competitive, and even more affordable than other quotes I had received for tank emptying.

A heartfelt thank you to Coastal Septic Solutions for their professionalism, expertise, and commitment to quality service. I’ll be recommending them to anyone I know with a septic system—because in a world of uncertainty in home maintenance, it’s a relief to find a company you can trust!!!

reviewsSample.author: Darlene Zorn
reviewsSample.text: A sewer backup occurred throughout the first floor of my house due to the city’s system. However, my house is over 100 years old and cameras run through my sewer line showed a lot of roots in my plumbing leading out to the city hookup. I had 2 plumbers tell me that my lines would need to be dug up out to the courtesy valve & replaced. That would involve digging up my patio and several sections of the sidewalk that I’d have to pay to have replaced at a cost well over $10K. I did a google search and found out about trenchless repair. The first company I called stated they were unable to come out for a few weeks because they were currently doing a big commercial job. Luckily I found The Pipe Boss & Will who responded promptly and gave me an estimate in a day. No digging &  half the price! The work was done in a day & he sent me a video showing my clear plumbing lines after the work was completed. All the roots were cleared out and the pipes were cleanly lined. Of all the companies I’ve had to deal with throughout the whole process of this sewer backup mitigation & restoration process, The Pipe Boss has been the best by far! Responsive, honest & efficient! No runaround, excuses or delays. A rare find that I’m happy to recommend to others!

reviewsSample.author: Tracey Kendrick
reviewsSample.text: Have a 1966 home with cast iron sewer in basement floor under concrete. Regular plumber wanted $12k to dig up concrete and replace pipe. Will and his team came in for about 4 hours lined the cast iron and was gone for a lot less money and no mess! These guys are the best. Up loaded an after picture of the newly lined pipe. Looks amazing.

reviewsSample.author: Rebecca Williams
reviewsSample.text: This is a wonderful company that I would highly recommend. I was quoted $16k by another company to clear a sewer line that had already been abandoned for a root issue. The wonderful people at Pipe Boss diagnosed the fairly routine issue, no roots in the line and were done in under an hour with an extremely reasonable price. I will definitely use them again. They are honest, knowledgeable and professional.

reviewsSample.author: Charles Massler
reviewsSample.text: The service provided by Will and his team, he is owner of The Pipe Boss, was truly exceptional. My wife and I are selling our home in Winston-Salem and the results of the buyer's inspection revealed 'something' in our main sewer line.  Being near the end of our due diligence period for the sale, Will fit us into his busy schedule and came to scope our sewer line within an hour of my calling him!  He then returned and cleared the debris, verified no breaks, and verified outstanding flow all the way to the street.  He provided us with a video for due diligence. I could not have asked for better better, more professional service. OUTSTANDING!!!

reviewsSample.author: Susan Brawley
reviewsSample.text: The Pipe Boss lined our pipes going from our house into our septic tank. The pipes were split laterally due to root intrusion. The pipes went under our patio and house, a three foot slab of concrete. The Pipe Boss saved us from having to bust up the concrete to replace the pipe. They inserted a sleeve into the split pipe. When the sleeve cured, it was like a new pipe. What a great idea! Will and his crew showed up when they said they would and did a great job! Will scheduled us quickly and saved us thousands of dollars. If you like to support small, family-owned businesses and need pipe work done, I highly recommend The Pipe Boss.

reviewsSample.author: Chuck Belisle
reviewsSample.text: Called this morning at 8AM and Darrin was already out working. He returned the call within a half hour and set up service for 5PM same day. reviewsSample.author: Dylan Blair
reviewsSample.text:
We recently had a completely clogged sewer drain and quickly realized our home didn’t even have a clean-out, which made the situation more complicated. BE Ohio came out and handled everything from start to finish with professionalism and efficiency.

They dug down to the existing sewer line and installed a brand new clean-out, which is a huge improvement and will make any future maintenance much easier. On top of that, they snaked and jetted the line and fully cleared the blockage. Now everything is flowing exactly as it should.

The team was knowledgeable, thorough, and took the time to make sure the job was done right—not just a quick fix. I really appreciate the long-term solution they provided. Highly recommend BE Ohio for anyone dealing with sewer or drain issues.

reviewsSample.author: Kyle Joos
reviewsSample.text: We had a great experience working with Colton and Kodi. They helped repair a damaged downspout quickly and professionally. The price was fair and transparent. The guys were prompt, knowledgeable, and made the repair quickly with little mess. It’s refreshing to work with a company that communicates clearly and delivers quality work on time. Highly recommend their services for anyone in need of excavating or plumbing work!

reviewsSample.author: Michelle Testa
reviewsSample.text: Great experience with BE Ohio. They were quick to respond, showed up on time, and got the job done efficiently. Everything was explained clearly and the pricing was fair. Professional, reliable, and easy to work with—would definitely recommend.

reviewsSample.author: Christopher Tudor
reviewsSample.text:
During a recent thunderstorm on Friday, our sump pump and backup sump pump failed us, causing our finished basement to flood around the outside perimeter. We tried another service that wouldn't have anyone around until the following Monday. We then were recommended BE Ohio by Schwartz Construction and BE Ohio responded immediately and came out within the hour.
After an initial assessment they were able to swiftly determine what replacement parts were needed, including a replacement sump pump, and gathered what they needed but didn't have on hand from local stores. They had the new pump in place in another hour. They didn't upcharge on any parts and charged a fair service fee.
BE Ohio also made recommendations for a full battery backup sump pump package from Zoeller that would bring us back to full coverage, including a possible warranty that would include coverage for damage to our basement. We'll be calling them again in the future for the installation of that package!

reviewsSample.author: Sandra Tapia
reviewsSample.text: I highly recommend Building and Excavating Ohio. My experience with the service provided by technician Kodi Hawkins was excellent—very professional and reasonably price, He explained everything related to the requested service on my food Truck!! Thank you kodi!!

reviewsSample.text: We had a miscommunication with All American Septic.  My assistant set up the free inspection and was not told he might do the work right after the inspection.  All American Septic has a policy that you must pay in cash or check right after the job is done.  But since my assistant was told it was just a free inspection, we were not prepared.  Once the job was completed, I get a call that he was demanding the full payment.  I ask if he can take an electronic payment and I hear him yelling at my partner in the background that in 20 years he has never been asked for an electronic payment.   I also hear him yelling that he was very clear on the cash or check right after the appointment.  My assistant told me she was not aware of any of this and she just thought we had a free inspection today.  I honestly don't know who dropped the ball, my assistant or All American Septic.  However, once we realized he wanted cash or check NOW, I worked with my partner to move as fast as we could to get him paid asap.  My partner let him know the miscommunication and how we were working to rectify the payment issue.  Yet he kept yelling at her that he would not leave until he was paid.  He then told her that he would charge her an additional $50 for every hour he had to wait.  We worked as quickly as we could.  I got the call about the payment at 11:04 am today.  We had him paid by 11:30 yet he demanded an extra $100 for the additional time he waited.  He originally told me $50 an hour but now he jacked the price up $100 for a 25 minute wait. This is fraud.  But honestly, we were willing to do anything at that point to get him to stop yelling at my partner.  I am a real estate investor and I am a repeat customer to many contractors.  I believe in treating my contractors right and they ALWAYS get paid.  I could have provided lots of business to All American Septic in the coming years.  But after this horrific experience, I will never work with them again.

reviewsSample.author: clay cherry
reviewsSample.text: Our ac unit went out after a power surge and of course it was after hours. It was on Monday 1st of June when it got a bit warm that day. I called around to a couple of places that said 24hr  7 day service. Can't mention any names but one told me that could take care of it on Monday of the next week. I called JT Services and they had someone here in 30 min. Chris showed up and checked everything over and it up and running in about 30 or 40 min. They are very dependable company to use for all your needs. This is the second time i have used their services. Thanks again

reviewsSample.author: pamela dunlap
reviewsSample.text: Had my annual air and heat inspection.  The employee was very knowledgeable and did a great job of explaining the issue  he found with my air conditioner.  He had the part and was able to get it installed  and had me back up and  running in no time. Very satisfied with all the times I have used JT Services!

reviewsSample.author: Paula Smith
reviewsSample.text: We've used JT Services a few times for multiple issues.   They are always very professional and everyone I've ever talked to seems knowledgeable and kind.   Chris has done work for us a few times and is always great.

reviewsSample.author: Scott Glattfelder
reviewsSample.text: Yesterday we had a Storm shelter installed that we have wanted for awhile. The crew showed up on time with equipment and new shelter. They layed out the dig area and started digging. When the hole was complete they leveled out the ground to set the shelter on. The drdriver backed the truck up to the hole and carefully set the shelter in place making sure it was level. They started back filling the dirt around it and smoothing out the the area in front of the shelter. Also they smoothed out the tracks from the equipment. They did an inside inspection, showed us how the door handle works and they were done.  Extremely professional and courteous.  Job Extremely well done. Dirt left will be for setting up a raised garden and for my new shop. 10 stars, very very professional.  The crew of Billy, Quincy and Justin including the tank hauler were great and knowledgeable.  All of the office personal were very professional also. Scott

reviewsSample.author: Nic Rushing
reviewsSample.text:
I've had troubles with water backing up into my house since December, had a bunch of plumbers ghost on me, and one who did all the indoor plumbing just great but couldn't do anything with septic. The ONLY company that did septic that could get out to me in less than a month was JT, and literally everyone involved was great, even if, at times, the circumstance was not so great. My house was built in 1950, and whoever did the septic lines should not have been doing them. Montavius Jackson came out first, was personable and knowledgeable, and let me know the bad news (some of my ceramic pipes in the leach field had completely crumbled, some were completely backed up) and I would need a new system. The owner came out the following week and reassured me it would be simple and easy, and then gave me the price tag. Needless to say, my eyes popped out of my head and I was stressed about how I was going to make 20k appear out of thin air. Jason called me back the next day to let me know he'd found a company (Eljen) willing to donate the materials for an alternative septic system that would work perfectly on my small property. It did take them two weeks to come out, but they communicated with me the whole way (Megan in the office is a rockstar, by the by), checking in every few days and even loaning me a portajohn for the time being.
Today, they came out, and everyone was chipper. I thought it would be impossible to get the whole thing done in just one day, but they did it!
If I could give more stars, I would! They were all so empathetic and kind and patient with my 800 questions, and went so above and beyond any expectations I had for professionals providing a service!

reviewsSample.author: Darla Tuttle
reviewsSample.text: I called and spoke with Jesse.  He had Ryan come out right away to fix my running toilet and the broken shut off valve.  Ryan was very professional and fixed the problems.  He also took a look at two of my outdoor faucets and gave me advice on those.  Ryan was very courteous and knew what he was doing.  I felt like they went out of their way to quickly get somebody to my house and they were very reasonably priced.  I will certainly use them for all of my future plumbing needs.  I was very happy with their service!  Thank you Dependable Plumbing!

reviewsSample.author: Susan Zalmanzig
reviewsSample.text: First impressions are key.  They responded within hours and thoroughly checked possible issues.  Made appropriate repairs and we were back up and running.

reviewsSample.author: Chrissy D
reviewsSample.text: I had a pipe burst during the snowstorm, and within an hour of reporting it to my landlord, I received a call. They were available immediately the next morning. I was hesitant to leave a stranger in my house with my dog and go to work, but upon meeting Steve and his partner , my hesitance disappeared .They fixed the pipe, and also fixed a sink that had incredibly low water pressure that I didn't even tell them about. I would recommend them to everyone.

reviewsSample.author: Ethan Sanderson
reviewsSample.text:
We had a issue with miscommunication at first but he really stepped in a showed fantastic customer service to fix the issue. I was able to send him photos of my issue before hand. Jesse made a plan ahead of time on how he would fix it. Not only was this a leak costing us property damage and a large water bill but trying to figure out this odd size plumbing that was done on our property that many plumbers(6)  before him wouldn’t even try. He came in with some speciality fittings and got it done within the hour!

Also, did I mention he did this after hours?!

reviewsSample.author: Brian's Heat and Air'
reviewsSample.text:
Renters said they could fix it..
But oh my, you know they called after their fix didn't work. I was in shock. But this Plumber, who I always recommend,  Saved the day..I figured they cross threaded, and etc, I was almost to embarrassed to even show this. Thank you Sir. Reason I always recommend you. If you want a fair, REALLY FAIR, PRICE, THis. Is the one to call.

reviewsSample.text: T&J Excavating built my RV park and retention pond (roads, pads, septic systems, drainage etc) and did a stellar job! William Drittler, owner of Candy Creek RV Park

reviewsSample.author: khristi no
reviewsSample.text: Trev and his crew are professional, knowledgeable patient and kind. Great resource for understanding what should be done to pass inspection and have a quality and lasting job.
