We would recommend T&J without hesitation, and have already done so! They have the equipment and personnel to do whatever is needed.

reviewsSample.author: charlene mason
reviewsSample.text: I am so happy I called Trev and his crew to come out and do the projects I needed done. They were very professional and patient in explaining their processes to me. I felt confident that they knew exactly what they were doing. They were wonderful about making sure they cleaned up and had everything just right before they would leave each day.  I will definitely contact them again if I need any projects done in the future.

reviewsSample.author: Eden Goble
reviewsSample.text: Trev at T&J is an excellent contractor.  He helped me develop a 15 acre section of land that was not easy.  His ability to read the land and carve out the property was amazing. reviewsSample.author: Melody Wilkins
reviewsSample.text: Absolutely a dream working with this company, They went above and beyond to help us get into a perfect shelter for us. The team from the front staff ladies to the young man pictured below, all the way up to the big boss lady where FUN and kind folks!

reviewsSample.author: Ceci you
reviewsSample.text:
Five years ago (this month I believe) i purchased a storm shelter from Firestorm. They had a specific company doing concrete work and our shelter took water within a week or two. Chip got them out to pump and seal it asap but it continued so he had them pull it and put a new one in.
The new one had issues with the door which was promptly repaired.
Last year we noticed it taking on water and I messaged him. The prior concrete company did him dirty and ran off.
We were in a drought the past year so havent see water, but a couple of weeks ago while we were in an active tornado warning I began recording because water was coming in from three places.
I sent this recording to Chip and he agreed that this should not be happening and replaced our shelter at his company's loss.
He was not rude with me at any point and was understanding to my frustration even. I appreciate the integrity they showed and I will continue to support, stand by, and recommend them to everyone!
Thank you to both Chip and Rachelle for standing on your word and good name and for the peace of mind my family has during a storm!

reviewsSample.author: Victor Reed
reviewsSample.text: This is my second purchase of a safe room from Firestorm Septic & Shelters and once again, they exceeded my expectations. The first purchase was a 6’x6’ steel interior safe room shelter through Michelle. Having moved, this time I purchased the 6’x8’ concrete exterior shelter through Rachelle. They have all 3 sizes on site so that you can physically determine the size that best suits your needs. Both ladies were very thorough and professional throughout the process, explaining in detail the construction process of each shelter and each of the safety features. Jaraay conducted yesterday’s site preparation and he too was very knowledgeable in his trade and worked with me in placing the concrete shelter just as I wanted. I am very pleased with both products and the installation process! I highly recommend their services!

reviewsSample.author: Brittania Magee
reviewsSample.text: Excellent company to work with, our project was completed in a timely manner with clear communication and attention to detail. Family owned business and a wonderful crew to have around. We are extremely pleased. Thank you Jeremy and crew!

reviewsSample.author: Cheryl Hogan
reviewsSample.text: My experience with BA French Drains was exceptional. Jeremy, the owner, was kind, professional, and kept me informed the entire time. It’s clear this is a family‑run business that takes pride in doing things the right way. The work was done with care, and the cleanup afterward was spotless. Companies like this are hard to find, and they’ve earned my full trust. I highly recommend BA French Drains.

reviewsSample.author: Julie Kellenberger
reviewsSample.text: The guys did an amazing job out in the horrific heat. They were professional,  friendly and extremely hard working. The drains look awesome afterwards. They cleaned up every tiny bit of the leftover supplies and tools. I appreciate their hard work. And Jeremy is a great guy, easy to work with. Highly recommend!!

reviewsSample.author: Tina Catlett
reviewsSample.text:
We couldn’t be happier with the work BA French Drains did installing French drains in our backyard. Before the installation, every heavy rain left us with what looked like a pond that would sit in our yard. With all of the recent storms and flash flooding, we were worried we’d have the same problem.

The real test came during the flash floods the other morning. Within a couple of hours, our backyard filled with water, but instead of standing there, the French drain system worked exactly as promised. The water drained quickly and was carried safely out to the street. It was amazing to watch the difference.

The crew was professional, knowledgeable, and did quality work from start to finish. They gave us daily updates of progress and a timeline of completion. If you’re dealing with drainage issues or standing water in your yard, I highly recommend them. The investment has already proven to be worth every penny.

reviewsSample.author: Terry F.
reviewsSample.text: We just finished having a French drain installed by BA French Drains. If you are looking for quality work, honest, hard workers, at a reasonable price then give Jeremy a call at BA French Drains. Expect to wait a bit for them to get to you but it’s well worth it. They will not cut corners and will work their butts off for you. Thank you BA French Drains. (we are drying out!!)

reviewsSample.author: Kristina
reviewsSample.text:
My septic was overflowing, and of course it happened right after my husband was going to be gone for an extended period of time, so I was totally at the mercy of whoever I called. Westside drain came out and problem solved through everything with me and made me feel so comfortable.

They had everything fixed that same day and for way less than I was thinking it would be. They took the time to explain to me everything that was happening and educate me about how everything works in general so now I know way more about the system that my house has. (My first septic as a homeowner)

It’s the only thing on our property that I know more about than my husband now 🤭

Highly recommend, and also have met the owners through a complete chance encounter - they are wonderful people.

reviewsSample.author: James Triana
reviewsSample.text: Great service provided. Technician showed up promptly and  messaged prior to arrival. They are very knowledgeable and respectful. Our property has been using West side over 7years and they never disappoint! Thank you.

reviewsSample.author: Angie sills
reviewsSample.text: We had a sudden backup! And they fit me in same day! Very professional and explained the issue. We got the line unclogged! And I was educated on the use of of over the counter drain chemicals! Only use a safe enzymatic once a month! The harsh chemicals from the drain chemicals can cause damage to pipe connections!

reviewsSample.author: Chris Bergemann
reviewsSample.text: West side drain was great! I called on Sunday, on Tuesday they came and cleaned my septic tank. I had a lot of questions about how septic tanks work since I never had one at my other homes. He spent extra time to explain everything to me. I'd highly recommend them.

reviewsSample.author: Jeremiah Kalleck
reviewsSample.text:
I had West Side Drain out to clean some grease interceptors at a property I manage. They were professional, timely, and had the foresight to check on a few things prior to our appointment which really streamlined the process. 100% will be working with them again in the future.

Bonus: I was speaking with another plumbing company who provides the same service, when I said who did our grease interceptor service their response was "They're a good outfit." You know a company does good work when their competition has nice things to say about them.

reviewsSample.author: Beth Degerstedt
reviewsSample.text: Tyler at "Just Send It Drain Cleaning" was highly recommended to me and I am thrilled to now be able to recommend this company's service after they worked on an overwhelming issue at my home. They were super friendly and shared their impressions along with some great suggestions. I felt immediate relief when they arrived and began working, and was really blown away when Tyler's associate took the time to clean the horrid mess in my tub prior to leaving! The total amount that I was charged was hundred of dollars less than what I was expecting based on a conversation with someone who had a similar issue to mine but used one of the companies with a name that is more familiar to most. So, honestly, do yourself a favor and contact this company for any issues with your drains. It was a pleasure to have worked with them and I highly recommend contacting them rather than any other company if you want outstanding service. Liz Degerstedt

reviewsSample.author: Jonathan Wright
reviewsSample.text: My Septic tank situation was unique and a huge problem. The previous owners had built an extension of the home ON TOP of the septic tank. A septic tank mind-you that was 60ish years old and hadn't been maintained or emptied in over 20ish years. Beyond stupid decision making on their part. Zach at Bonzo and his workers were expert at handling the situation and repairing/replacing the old plumbing and installing the new septic tank. The old septic tank was dug into and emptied as much as possible. It feels so good to have working plumbing and be confident that it was done properly. 10/10 I recommend.

reviewsSample.author: Brenda Getz
reviewsSample.text:
Bonzo Septic Repair and his team did excellent work at installing a new septic tank at my house. He had to use a huge crane to lift the tanks over the house. It was exciting to see.
Zac and his team were friendly, knowledgeable and professional.
It was a pleasure doing business with him and his wife Stephanie.
I would definitely recommend his services in the future.
Thank you so very much for an amazing job.
Brenda G

reviewsSample.author: Nicholas Black
reviewsSample.text: Bonzo Septic has helped us with several issues at our home. Every experience we have had with their crew is always pleasant and enjoyable! They respect your time, show up when scheduled too, and very competitive pricing. They are my go to when I am in need of their services.

reviewsSample.author: Sierra D'Amico
reviewsSample.text: Unfortunately while trying to close on a house, we had a nightmare with the septic situation. Our closing window was tight and Bonzo excavating worked diligently to make sure we had everything we needed in a timely manner. There was some work done by another company during this time by the sellers that was less than desirable, but with Bonzo excavating’s expertise everything was fixed and the work was quality. We ended up with a brand new septic system for a reasonable price that was installed with careful attention to detail. Communication with the team was always easy and handled in a timely manner as well. I would highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: Ryan A
reviewsSample.text: Excellent work done on my septic system. Good communication and better price on repairs than the bids received from other companies! Highly recommended!!

reviewsSample.text:
Service completed: March 2024.

100% recommend and will be using Mike's Septic Service in the future!

This was our first time getting our septic tank cleaned out since buying our home in the area and we were not familiar with the companies in the area. After reading reviews about Mike's Septic Service, we knew we couldn't go wrong with this company. We were not disappointed!

The new owner, Grant, is a down to earth person who wants to ensure the customers are happy and their needs are met. I scheduled an appointment by phone and he was able to complete a routine service within 2 weeks (mind you I told him there was no rush- great for me!). The day before the appointment, he confirmed our scheduled date and time. He showed up about 30 minutes earlier then our scheduled time, which was wonderful! While he was here, he was very respectful and also explained what he completed. He also did not try to pressure me into having unneeded services completed, which is almost unheard of anymore. To top it off, his prices were very reasonable.

Don't look any further, call Mike's Septic Service!

Arrived on time, great personality, was happy to answer our many questions.  Treated the flowerbeds and yard carefully while working in them.  Explained how we need to maintain the system in between services.  Felt his pricing was very reasonable.  We will definitely be repeat customers.

Thanks for the small town hospitality and welcome, not. I will never recommend them to anyone. Grants work ethic SUCKS!!

reviewsSample.author: Laurie Ort
reviewsSample.text:
I found Affordable Septic Services through a Google search when searching for local Septic cleaning companies , and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the very first call, they responded the same day, communicated exactly as promised, and followed through on everything they said they would do. The price was incredibly affordable with no surprise charges, they arrived on time, kept me updated by text, and even sent the invoice promptly as promised.

It’s rare to find a company that’s this reliable, honest, and professional. The entire process was seamless from start to finish. 10/10 experience—I will absolutely use them again and highly recommend them to anyone needing septic services!

reviewsSample.author: Christian Conti-Vock
reviewsSample.text: My effluent pump stopped working and its tank nearly overflowed.  Fred was willing to visit late in the day to pump the tank and diagnose the trouble. When I expressed interest in replacing the pump myself, he generously recommended specific parts, supporting materials, brands, specifications, installation tips, and local vendors.  Outstanding ethic and attitude.  I highly recommend Fred and Affordable Septic Services!

reviewsSample.author: Christina Zychal
reviewsSample.text:
Affordable Septic Services came through for me in a true emergency. My septic system stopped draining at 9 PM on a Sunday, and I expected to leave a voicemail—but the owner answered personally. After I explained the situation, he didn’t hesitate to fit me in first thing Monday morning at 7:30 AM.

He arrived exactly when he said he would, quickly assessed the problem, explained everything clearly, and went out of his way to fix the issue. Within two hours, my system was fully up and running again. He cleaned up the entire area, was friendly, kind, and professional, and the pricing was genuinely affordable.

This is a wonderful local company with exceptional service. I highly recommend Affordable Septic Services to anyone who needs reliable, honest, and fast help.

Chris Z, a local Spring Grove resident

reviewsSample.author: Michelle Coen
reviewsSample.text: Very pleased with ProSeptic. Kayla was very kind and helpful. She gave me her cell to text for faster responses. She was also able to move our scheduled date sooner when requested. The technician that came out was very respectful and knowledgeable. I would highly recommend!

reviewsSample.author: eliza zimmermann
reviewsSample.text: I called on a Saturday because my septic alarm was going off. Although they do not service my weird septic system, the gentleman on the phone went out of his way to help me troubleshoot a few things and more importantly put my mind at ease that my entire house was not about to fill with up with sewage 😂. I could tell he was out and about probably trying to enjoy his day but the fact that he took 10 minutes to speak with me when he would get nothing in return was surprising and very kind. I would highly recommend them to anyone needing help!

reviewsSample.author: Durkin Cottages
reviewsSample.text: Called for an emergency pump out and they were able to accommodate within an hour when no other companies were available. Very nice and easy to work with. Highly recommend.

reviewsSample.author: David Kiernan
reviewsSample.text: Joe, at ProSeptic, had done some work for us in 2018 to improve our septic system. Recently, water was starting to drain more slowly from the house. I called Joe on Saturday and he came over on Monday to look at it. He opened up the inspection port for the distribution box and immediately knew what was wrong. Tree roots had gotten into it. He went to his truck, came back with a hook and was luckily able to pull them all out. Water started to flow out immediately to the leach field. Problem solved. I was thrilled. He set up an appointment for the next day to get the septic tank pumped and the D-box cleaned. I can't thank him enough for solving this for us quickly and as it turned out inexpensively. Great company, and great guy.

reviewsSample.author: Jeffrey Murray
reviewsSample.text: If you have type of person that reads reviews…. Then trust me on this one and read no further…. These guys are the absolute best than the business…. They are honest and they are affordable…. I have locked them into my phone and will never use anyone else if I have another problem again…. If I could give them 100 stars, I would

reviewsSample.author: Tiffany
reviewsSample.text: I've been looking for a company for awhile to service my septic tank, & I've found the right one. The communication, the scheduling & service was top tier, so that's a PLUS! Also the pricing was very reasonable as well compared to others. The young men arrived on time jumped right into the job & within no time was done. If ever in need of septic system service I would highly recommended this company. Thanks Brian & company

reviewsSample.author: Roger Cole
reviewsSample.text: Outstanding company! I called them and they were at my house within 30 minutes. I had a difficult situation and they figured it out and got right to work. Extremely knowledgeable and hard workers. They took care of my problem quickly and their price was absolutely reasonable. I highly recommend this company!

reviewsSample.author: Casey Gaskins
reviewsSample.text: A great family owned business! Brian is upfront and honest about cost and services that need to be done. I've had to call them out several times because someone was pouring grease down our sink and it was causing a backup. If there is something going on that his services won't cover, he's great about giving recommendations and referrals! Check them out for any septic needs and see what other services he offers.

reviewsSample.author: Greg Ryle
reviewsSample.text:
This is the second time in under 3 years I have needed to use A1 and 2 Septic Services.  The first time was the day after we purchased this property. If things could go wrong they had. Brian and his son were out in very short time and identified roots had gotten into the septic tank and blocked the inlets.  They then proceeded to inspect the tank and said I didn’t need a flush. At that point (30 months ago) it couldn’t be determined when it had last been flushed. Brian could have easily said it did and charged me, but he conducts business with the utmost integrity.

Fast forward to today and I had hoped it was the same issue.  This time it was not. The tank needed to be pumped. Brian was at my house in under 25 minutes from when I dialed his number. I am writing this review with an empty septic tank and it hasn’t even been an hour since I placed the call.  Please know when it comes to issues like these, timelines is crucial, and A1 and 2 septic have that covered!

reviewsSample.author: Jared Krieger
reviewsSample.text: I called looking for a clean out of my septic tank, they were very professional and fast. They were out within 30 minutes and had the job finished within the hour. Couldn't of asked four a better job. Highly recommended and will be using them again in the future!

reviewsSample.author: Hailey Fritts
reviewsSample.text: Hinson Septic Tank Pumping came out the day after I called and provided excellent service. They did an amazing job emptying our septic tank and gave us very helpful advice about replacing our sewer lines. They were super friendly and just great people all around. The price was very fair, and we will definitely use them again. I highly recommend them!

reviewsSample.author: Shanna Chapman
reviewsSample.text: I have NEVER dealt with a septic system before! My pipes were leaking or so I thought,water coming up the burp pipe (my name for the drain pipe outside), and none of my sinks nor toilets flushed nor drained! I panicked! Called this company and left message! Within 30 mins he called me back and was at my home within 2 hrs!!! He was on another job site, otherwise he would have been right there! He located the tank, dug the hole, emptied the tank, filled the hole back up, and even gave us advice on the type of tissue we should use! I am forever grateful for a company to be so efficient and still have amazing customer service, especially as cold as it has been! Again, we THANK YOU for all that you do for us! And the price was amazing as everyone told me it would cost a fortune! Your business and service gets a 10 star rating with me!!!

reviewsSample.author: Sarah Barker

I was out of town due to a death in the family when I got the call from my pet sitter that the toilets wouldn’t flush and the tub downstairs had standing water in it. I called Hinson septic and explained the situation. They were out the same day and had it fixed in a few hours. Being 8 hours away from home when something like this happens can be overwhelming, but Hinson septic made me feel at ease and did what needed to be done. I appreciate y’all more than you will ever know! Thank you again!

reviewsSample.text: Hinson Septic Tank is your #1 choice! They are courteous,  professional, friendly,  and will update you on how everything is going. They also take the time to share their findings and explain any issues that maybe happening in the future! Highly, highly recommend!

He called to let me know he was heading to the house and gave me plenty of time to get back home from work to visually inspect the system issues with him. He was very kind and professional throughout his work, Thank you Jimmy. I will definitely be recommending your services to anyone looking.

reviewsSample.author: Sonia Bodziony
reviewsSample.text:
An amazing company!
We were experiencing some issues with our septic and Montgomery’s came out promptly.
After inspection and discussions, they outlined a potential plan for repair and perhaps replacement of some field lines. Montomery’s handled the app to the State and writhin a couple days the State Inspector ( Michelle ) arrived.  A thorough inspection was conducted and her suggestions were shared with us.
Within a day the application and detailed options were received by Montgomery’s and they reached out right away to discuss our options.
Our contact st Montgomery’s was Ben and he was wonderful. He kept in touch with us promptly, provided details, suggestions, and expectations for us.  We planned for a repair and if need be, a replacement of the lines  Ben arrived with equipment and supplies to complete the job. They conducted their work with the upmost  are and concern for our property and were attentive to our requests during the digging and removal of dirt.
They located the issue promptly and happily share the news that it is repairable and a larger replacement job was not necessary.
The repair was completed and they used precision to return the area to well suitated area and not a torn up yard and eyesore. From beginning of the first call to the end when they drove away, Ben was outstanding providing details and steps that were being used.
Thank you Montgomery’s and huge thank you to Ben.

reviewsSample.author: Erica Bragg
reviewsSample.text: Great experience from start to finish! They were prompt, professional, and explained everything clearly. Ben and his crew did a great job and made sure to communicate with me before doing any work. The crew cleaned up after and left very minimal evidence they were there! I felt as though I got great service for the price i paid. I will definitely be recommending and using Montgomery’s in the future!

reviewsSample.author: David Bianchi
reviewsSample.text: Montgomery did an amazing job for us. Everyone we dealt with was professional, friendly, and really knew what they were doing. They took the time to explain the issue and made sure we understood what was going on instead of just fixing it and leaving. They were able to fit us into their schedule quickly and fixed a problem that could have turned into a major home issue if it hadn’t been handled fast. The service was quick, the staff was great, and the whole experience was stress-free. I would absolutely recommend Montgomery to anyone needing reliable, honest work.

reviewsSample.author: Ayla S.
reviewsSample.text: Cam and his crew have been spectacular every time we've ever needed them for septic service or installation. They're professional, knowledgeable, and meticulous. If you want a clean and professional job done, call Montgomery's for your septic needs. Not to mention their professionalism doesn't end with septic jobs only. Mongomery's also offers additional services, providing porta-potties and wash stations. We will only ever use their porta-potties and wash stations because of how clean and well-maintained they are. We have solely used Montgomery's Septic Service for our annual 4th of July parties for the past few years, and they have always been perfect.  If you need porta-potties and wash stations, this is the absolute best place to get them from. Not to mention, Brittany is always wonderful to work with! As a fellow family-owned and operated company, Cam and Brittany truly understand what it takes to provide great customer service by always being personable and hardworking. They both absolutely pour their hearts and souls into their company daily, and it really shows. Neither will try to steer you wrong just to make a buck. They will advise you accordingly and keep you informed as the job progresses. Which always means a lot to my spouse and me. Simply put, Montgomery’s is a wonderful company, wonderful family, and they always provide wonderful service!!!

reviewsSample.author: Greg J
reviewsSample.text:
We called Montgomery's a couple of months ago, because our septic tank was overflowing into the yard. I expected needing a new system, and was prepared for the worse.

They came out, pumped the tank, and took the time to probe the entire drain line. They determined that the drain line was probably good. It appeared to be a problem in one area close to the tank, and they were confident that they could repair it by just bypassing the problem area.

I told them to give it a try, and they successfully repaired everything for a fraction of the cost of a new system.

I am so thankful that they took the time to inspect the entire system. I know most contractors would have just came out and sold me a new system, when the problem area was literately a broken pipe leaving the septic tank.

A couple of months later, everything is draining fine!

reviewsSample.author: Marc deClaire
reviewsSample.text:
I had an excellent experience with England Septic Service. When I called about an issue with my septic system, they responded the same day, which was incredibly impressive. Their team was professional, knowledgeable, and took the time to explain what was going on with my septic tank and how they were going to fix it.

The work was completed quickly and everything was handled the right way. It’s clear that England Septic Service takes pride in providing reliable septic service and taking care of their customers.

If you’re looking for a dependable septic company that responds quickly and does quality work, I highly recommend England Septic Service.

reviewsSample.author: Stacey Scott
reviewsSample.text: Outstanding!  Rob was terrific.  Showed up exactly when he said he would be here.  My spouse isn’t always easy to deal with, but Rob totally impressed him.  Kudos to Rob & your team.

reviewsSample.author: Kevin Haberstroh
reviewsSample.text: We were having a septic issue at our new house and we didn't know when it had last been pumped or even where the tank was. I called England Septic on a Friday afternoon and he came out Saturday morning. Robert was cheerful, helpful, and easy to work with. We had to dig around a little but he found our tank quickly and the pumping was done efficiently and he was out of here in under 2 hours.

reviewsSample.author: Donald Hutchinson
reviewsSample.text: First thing I wanna say is how amazing Mr. England was and professional!! He located our septic tank with no problem had it pumped and cleaned out within an hour. Now, all my neighbors around me, wanna have theirs done by England septic. Anytime we need ours pumped again in the future he will definitely be called. I highly recommend Rob. Like I said, he was very nice very informative and very professional thank you Rob for the great service. It’s good nowadays to see someone that does their job professionally…

reviewsSample.author: E J
reviewsSample.text: Rob just pulled out of my driveway after a job well done, and I simply had to head straight to my phone to leave him a 5-star review. When I was looking for a company to come pump my septic tank, England Septic's reviews convinced me that he could do the job and do it well. Now that I've actually seen him in action, I can fully attest to the reason why his Google review score is so high. When I first called him for an estimate, he answered his phone right away. When I called him to schedule the appointment, he answered right away. You may be wondering why I'm telling you this-- it's because there are, unfortunately, companies that will send you to voicemail and/or never call you back. He was able to schedule me right away and arrived when he said he would--no waiting around for hours on someone to show up. He was polite, respectful, professional, and hardworking. He patiently listened to my many questions and answered them thoroughly in a way that I could understand. He worked hard and didn't stop until the job was complete. He dug down to my tank, pumped out both sides of the tank (liquids and solids), reburied the tank back to the way it was, and did all of this for a very reasonable price. I am quite impressed, and if I need any help with septic tank issues in the future, Rob England will be the one I call. Thank you, Rob!!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviewsSample.author: Regena Gunter
reviewsSample.text: HIGHLY RECOMMEND! supporting our local plumbing guy and he did not disappoint! He came to help us get water the day after I called. He troubleshot a plumbing nightmare with courtesy and fantastic customer service! If you need a great professional plumber, Tankersly plumbing is your guy!

reviewsSample.author: AR
reviewsSample.text:
I cannot say enough great things about Tankersley Plumbing. From start to finish, the experience was exceptional.

Casey was the first person I spoke with and his professionalism immediately stood out. He was incredibly prompt in returning my call, patient in answering all of my questions and extremely polite throughout the entire conversation. When he arrived at my home, his presence was warm, respectful and reassuring. You could immediately tell he was knowledgeable and confident in his work, which gave me a great sense of comfort moving forward.

I also want to recognize Mr. Shad for his incredible craftsmanship and expertise. It was clear that he takes pride in his work and truly understands the details of what he does. He navigated the job with experience and precision, making adjustments where needed and ensuring everything was done correctly the first time. His ability to assess the situation and pivot when necessary really demonstrated the level of professionalism and skill he brings to the job.

My HOA has very strict requirements, which made finding a plumber extremely challenging to install my water heater(in the attic). I had to turn away several contractors because they did not meet the requirements of being properly licensed, bonded and insured. Tankersley Plumbing not only met those requirements but handled everything efficiently and professionally, ensuring I had exactly what I needed to remain in compliance.

What started as a stressful situation quickly turned into a smooth and positive experience thanks to this team. They were efficient, organized, knowledgeable, and respectful of my home. The quality of the work and the level of customer care truly stood out.

If you are looking for a trustworthy, professional plumbing company that takes pride in their work and treats customers with respect, I highly recommend Tankersley Plumbing. I am extremely grateful that I found them.

reviewsSample.author: Jonathan Strausser
reviewsSample.text: This is JONATHAN with American Veterans Restoration. I am highly impressed with the services that Tankersly Service  was able to provide to my business and customers . I highly recommend this company. Their customer service and their technicians were polite and prompt.

reviewsSample.author: Jason Ware
reviewsSample.text: Tankersley Plumbing has done a fantastic job of working on our leak at our house.  We had an insurance claim and they have been here for us every step of the way.  Michael and Shad and the people at the office have been very kind and helpful. I would highly recommend.

reviewsSample.author: David Johnson
reviewsSample.text: I own a plumbing company in Atlanta and referred a local friend to Tankersley. They did an awesome job, priced it correctly and we're very polite. Will recommend to everyone in Memphis from now on.

reviewsSample.author: Ricky Mcneely
reviewsSample.text: Highly recommend them if needed. The gentleman and lady that came out was highly respectful answered any questions I had this is my 3rd are 4th time using them and I will use them in the future thank y'all so much.

reviewsSample.author: Ronald Sloan
reviewsSample.text:
Big Dog proved to be trustworthy, reliable, and focused on doing things the right way—not just about making a dollar. I had a septic and plumbing issue that caused gray water to back up into the house whenever the washing machine was used. They quickly diagnosed and resolved the problem. When the time came to complete the repair, I couldn’t be home, but they were completely comfortable working inside and outside the house while I was away, which showed their integrity and professionalism.

What really stood out was their honesty—they didn’t ask for payment until the system had been tested for a couple of weeks to ensure everything was working properly. I even felt their price was too low for all the work they did, but they insisted they charge what’s fair and don’t take advantage of homeowners.

I highly recommend Big Dog for any septic or drainage needs. They’re honest people who take pride in their work.

I have also been happy with them pumping out my septic tank.

reviewsSample.author: Max Williams
reviewsSample.text:
~UPDATE.~
After posting pictures with my original review, they did send someone out late on a Saturday to address the yard. It is no longer mounded up and is in a usable condition.

The guy they sent out was polite and apologized for how long it took to get this fixed.

I did help with spreading some dirt and rolling the area with my mower to finish faster due to the sun setting. Luckily i have jobsite lights so we were able to finish it up before the weather turned on us.

The yard is in an acceptable state that I can live with. My main issue was how long it took to get the yard flattened out. Hopefully this was just an isolated incident, I get some things just fall through the cracks sometimes.

~ORIGINAL REVIEW~
Got the permit Jun 9th, job was "completed" July 8th, yard has been mounded up since July. Its December 9th, I have called 4 times to get on the schedule for them to come flatten out the yard like they said they would. Every time I call they say yeah no problem we can be out there next week weather depending.
I asked them to just flatten it out before they left cause I know that 3 foot of dirt is not going to settle back to grade but i let the guy talk me into coming back after a "couple of good rains" to flatten it out the rest of the way, if he did it would be fine. If he flattened it before he left I may have some runs to fill in after a while but at least I could mow that part of the yard.
if this review doesn't get them to show up, the $4500 septic lines that I paid in full for will cost equipment rental on top of it to finally get my yard back. Nice people but this is unacceptable.
When my yard gets fixed I will update this review.

reviewsSample.author: Dawn Davis
reviewsSample.text: I had the pleasure of meeting Brian and his sweet wife when they came to pump out my septic tank.  They were very thorough and fast.  Such a honest hard working family.  I HIGHLY RECOMMEND them for your septic needs.

reviewsSample.author: Eric Mayfield
reviewsSample.text: Called them today (Memorial Day) at 745 am and they had someone out in about an hour!!! Great people, great service and very reasonable on price. You need someone really good, call the BIG DOG!! Thank yall!!!

reviewsSample.text: The technician was very polite and professional. He assessed my issue checked for water damage and fixed the problem on the spot. I called them and they came out the same day too. Very happy with the service will go to them again for sure.

reviewsSample.text: Ryan and Matthew at Stifflers came and set  my new waste water pipes to my new building yesterday.  They gave me by far the best price, and they did by far the best job that my family has ever done by a plumbing company. I would most definitely highly recommend them. They are not only the best professionally but courteous,  respectful, and the nicest people. Thank you, Ryan and Matthew!!! If we ever have any problems in the future, we will most definitely be calling them!!

reviewsSample.author: Q W
reviewsSample.text: Very impressed with the service received. I called one morning due to water heater leak from t&p valve. I was told that a technician would be dispatched that afternoon. I received a text at 1:15 pm that technician would arrive between 1:30-3:30 pm. Matthew arrived exactly at 1:30 pm to assess the problem and it was recommended to replace it due to the age of the water heater. Matthew had the old water heater and the new water heater installed in less time than estimated. The new water heater has been a true upgrade for consistent hot water. I am very thankful that I took a chance and made the call. I will definitely recommend Stiffler’s to anyone needing plumbing services.

reviewsSample.author: Stacey Hoffman
reviewsSample.text:
Ryan and Matthew were personable and professional.
They went out of their way to get the materials needed. The work was completed efficiently and they cleaned up afterwards. I highly recommend them for plumbing services.

reviewsSample.text: Scott is amazing - He is kind, courteous, helpful, knowledgeable, reasonably priced and most importantly he is honest.  He has fixed our problems quickly. He replaced the old fixtures as well as removing the tub. He cleaned up everything before he left leaving our bathroom like a showroom. We will call Scott again when the need arises.

reviewsSample.author: Mary McCooley, Realtor
reviewsSample.text: Emerson Plumbing is absolutely the best originally we hired a different company to run a gas line for our new fireplace and they were here two days for a total of 18 hours and still could not get my new fireplace to light. Scott Emerson was here 20 minutes and had it all hooked up if you have any plumbing needs whatsoever you really need to call Scott. He’s the best.

reviewsSample.author: Belinda Cornell
reviewsSample.text: Scott is the only plumber I intend to call for all future jobs. He has come out two times to my house. My husband and I are really impressed with his work, and he is very reasonable in price.   He came to our house very soon after we called him and replaced an outdoor spigot for us. It looks great and doesn't leak anymore. He communicates well, is very professional, and most importantly he is a fantastic plumber! Call him. You will be happy you did!!

reviewsSample.author: Kayla Laurin
reviewsSample.text: I had a great experience with Scott. He was friendly, professional, and communicated clearly throughout the entire process. He arrived on time, worked efficiently, and explained everything in a way that was easy to understand. The quality of his work was excellent, and I felt confident that the job was done right. I would absolutely hire him again and highly recommend him to anyone looking for reliable plumbing services.

reviewsSample.author: Rocky Williams
reviewsSample.text:
As a general contractor, I need subcontractors who are reliable, efficient, reasonably priced, and capable of delivering quality workmanship under tight timelines. Scott and his team exceeded expectations on every level. They quickly resolved multiple plumbing issues, including leaking sink shutoff valves and a shower repair, while maintaining a high standard of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

What stood out most was their professionalism, communication, and problem-solving approach. They identified additional issues with several toilets that could have easily been overlooked and took the time to explain the best long-term solutions and finish options. Their team was thorough, respectful of the property, and never made the job feel rushed. They stayed until everything was completed properly and every question was answered.

It’s hard to find plumbing contractors who combine responsiveness, fair pricing, quality work, and customer service this well. Scott and his team have earned a spot as my go-to plumbers moving forward.

reviewsSample.author: Ashlee Wagoner
reviewsSample.text:
Highly recommend!! We had quotes from several companies. One, I love that TruFlow quoted over the phone. The company that was most highly recommended to us had to come visit to give an estimate and was then DOUBLE the price that TruFlow was!! I’m still in shock. (Freedom Plumbing)

He called ahead of time, was so kind, knowledgeable, saved us money where he could,  and was genuinely just a good guy!

Thank you so so so much!

reviewsSample.author: Nicole Boyd
reviewsSample.text: We experienced some plumbing issues and were referred to TruFlow for assistance. A previous technician from another company had visited but was unable to diagnose the problem. Therefore, I contacted Erik from TruFlow, who quickly arranged an appointment. Upon his arrival, he evaluated the situation and realized he needed a specific part that he didn’t have on hand. He promptly left to retrieve it from a hardware store and returned in a timely manner, successfully locating the source of the blockage. Erik was efficient, professional, and courteous, delivering exceptional service. Additionally, his pricing was very reasonable. I will certainly choose his company for future plumbing needs and highly recommend TruFlow for anyone seeking plumbing services.

reviewsSample.author: Erick C.
reviewsSample.text: Great company! Erik was on time, great communication, very knowledgeable and price was very reasonable.  He fixed an issue with my pipes making noise that another plumber from a big company couldn't figure out in 2 separate visits! Turns out it was from a part in my toilet.  Definitely will use again.

reviewsSample.author: C L
reviewsSample.text:
Erik was great! His fast service brought quick relief to my stress. He came out to my home the very same day I called! You can tell he is very knowledgeable about plumbing, drainage, and he even does gas repair. Professional, polite, and affordable. I definitely recommend him and appreciated his honesty.

One day prior, a mold inspector had led me to believe I had an ongoing plumbing leak. Erik was able to thoroughly walk through my workshop and crawl space and reassure me that there is no leaking, at this time. He said there must have been a leak from the toilet in the past, which is visible by remnant dark spots. He said that rather than having a bad mold problem in our subfloor, it’s dry and more likely to be wood rot that needs replacing when we get around to renovating the second bath (instead of a large priority crisis).

Erik took the time to also advise me on a loose dishwasher, showed me where to hook up my under sink water filter, tested my tricky gas fireplace, and lastly, he tightened up my super wobbly toilet in the master. I will use him for any future plumbing or gas needs.

Thank you for your help, Erik!

reviewsSample.author: Amber Hanika
reviewsSample.text: Erik came to the rescue when the company my home warranty sent out was trying to rip me off he got it done in just a few days!!! Excellent, professional and speedy service!!!

reviewsSample.author: Mickey Hilton-Roney
reviewsSample.text: Bathroom and basement had flooded on Saturday night. He came then to take a look and give me a free estimate. Came back Sunday morning at 9. It had backed up and stopped up the pipes. He got those unstopped. Found the sump pump in the basement had a small hole. Worked on that. Total charge 375. No kidding. He's a really good Christian man who does the right thing even when he doesn't have to. I will Never use anyone else!!!

reviewsSample.author: hannah southerland
reviewsSample.text:
Have to share this "restore faith in humanity" story🥹

Many of you know we lived in a camper for a little over a year while we were building. We had to have our black tanks pumped monthly, so we hired Collin's Septic Service. Mr. Collin's and his son came rain, snow or shine any time we called them. They are some of the kindest people you will ever meet. Our girls would wait at the tiny window on the side of the camper to give them their money every time they came. They quickly became friends and looked forward to "the poopy guys🤣🤪" coming.
Once we moved into the new house the girls started praying for them nightly, and I don't think they've missed a single night of asking God to watch over them.
Yesterday, we heard a knock at the door and there was Mr. Collin's! He stopped by to visit and wish us a Merry Christmas and left the girls with new stuffed animals and $100 for Christmas gifts😭❤️ There are still really, really good people left in the world!
If you need any septic work done, call them!! They are so kind and honest

reviewsSample.author: Amanda hawkins
reviewsSample.text: We called at 5pm yesterday and he came out this morning. Super nice and very professional. Roto rooter told me I needed blueprints and he came out and found It no problem. Will definitely use them again!!

reviewsSample.author: Jennifer Fredrichs
reviewsSample.text: Mr. Collins is a great guy very nice and a great personality and will tell you what need to fix a line and tell you how so you can save money. Hes always extremely polite and caring. I have never used anyone else. I would recommend him to everyone. Hes on time and if he can he'll fit you in between pumping jobs. Great guy!

reviewsSample.author: Chip Downs
reviewsSample.text: While we weren't able to do business due to a steep driveway, these people really impressed me. They called as promised, and even took time to drive all the way out to see if there was anyway he could do the work. It got better when he called me! He said that he was very sorry but he wasn't able to service our tank, and then gave me a recommendation to someone else in the business who could help. In my opinion, and after 40+ years of customer service, these people are very professional.

reviewsSample.author: Vacation Outfitters
reviewsSample.text:
If you face septic tank woes, look no further than Shamrock Septic Service! Our experience with their fantastic team has indeed been a breath of fresh air. They came to our rescue when we encountered troubling issues with our septic tanks and drain field, guiding us through the process with expertise and professionalism.
What struck us the most was their dedication to customer care. They were always responsive, respectful, and genuinely interested in resolving our problems effectively. Thanks to their thorough service and knowledge, we not only sorted out our issues but also learned a great deal about maintaining our system for the future.
We cannot recommend Shamrock enough! They’ve earned the title of our new go-to septic tank doctor—a huge thank you to their outstanding team for putting us at ease during a stressful time. We’ll be seeing you again for our next service.

reviewsSample.author: Sommer Rogers
reviewsSample.text:
I definitely recommend Tyler & Chris!
You can tell how much they care about their business & their customers - they treated us so well today. I can’t thank them enough for their kindness & hard work.
If you’re having septic issues, give them a call - they’ll get you fixed up! Will definitely use them again in the future for any septic needs.

reviewsSample.author: Joce C
reviewsSample.text: Thank you for going above and beyond for an emergency call out and fitting us into your busy schedule. Shamrock Septic was the only company willing to go the extra mile (literally) to help with a messy situation. We appreciate you very much and will be referring our friends and neighbors to you. Thank you again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviewsSample.author: ACR
reviewsSample.text:
We recently bought a house that has a septic system and upon inspection (from a different company) we were told that the system was in "complete failure". We called the guys at Shamrock Septic just to have the system pumped while we waited for the other company to start the new system.

Upon some digging and inspection Tyler, Chris and Scott were able to figure out that the main pipe had collapsed due to root growth and that they could fix the pipe and the hopefully the problem, saving us from having to purchase a whole new ($8,000-$10,000) system.

They went above and beyond to help us, potentially saving us thousands of dollars on a new system. Being newbies to septic systems we appreciated their explanations and their knowledge.
We highly recommend Shamrock Septic and will definitely use them again in the future!

reviewsSample.author: Texas Blues
reviewsSample.text: The guys did a great job replacing our broken septic tank lid. Also back flushed the clogged outlet pipe. System is now working great! Will be calling them again if needed.

Our neighbors recommended them and I could not be happier! They do great work and good business. 10/10 do recommend anytime someone says they need a septic company.

reviewsSample.author: Julie Zavala
reviewsSample.text: I would give the guy who came out to take care of our septic (Derrel?) five stars. He was great and had good information for us about maintenance on our system. My problem is with the office staff. I think the girl’s name is Kelly - I’ve called her at least three times to get a quote for moving the septic aerator pump higher up. She didn’t call me back the first time, said she would get me a quote for the work the second time I called and the third time I called she told me that someone named Matthew would call me back with a quote. Matthew never called. That’s just a bad reflection on the company. If you don’t want to do the job or you’re short handed and don’t have anyone to come out please just tell me. I’m an adult, I can take it, but don’t leave me in limbo.

reviewsSample.author: Dr. John David Paul Howard
reviewsSample.text:
Outstanding customer care from Kelli, Wyatt, Daniel, and Mathew that we worked with. The whole family owned business ran as a super team! Any questions or problems we had were immediately acknowledged and solved.
The technicians who came to help were nice in explaining what they were doing and why. We are now lifelong customers!

reviewsSample.author: Elizabeth Latham
reviewsSample.text: Oh my gosh!! A+ Septic literally saved our Wednesday! We were out of town and the light to the septic came on. As soon as we called they were able to get out here the next day and not only fix our issues, but found another issue and fixed that as well! Mike and Darrell were very helpful and knowledgeable as well! Can’t beat A+ Septic!!

reviewsSample.author: Patti Montgomery
reviewsSample.text: The A+ team was professional, courteous and a pleasure to work with. They were careful with our property and explained what they were doing and why our tank had stopped draining. I highly recommend their services.

reviewsSample.author: Chad Anselmo
reviewsSample.text:
Be Cautious dealing with A+.    The came and repaired 50' of septic line.   Original quote was $3K, asked for a downpayment of $6K, then charged me $15K (price wasn't given to me until after the job was done)!  Wait no, they charged me $15,275.00 since they charge $275 to come out and look at anything.   I had the same thing done on the other side of the house and it was $4K by another company.   I admit some of this is on me because I kept on calling them to come back and fix it after charging me the $275 just to look at it (they took over a week to finally come back).  The pictures show their quality.   For a 2" pipe they tore up 4 irrigation lines (and didn't repair), one electrical pipe (yep, didn't repair), and left the yard in muddy mess with massive tractor ruts everywhere (not to speak of the lawn they destroyed).   And the icing on the cake, one week later, on the pipe they repaired, sewage started bubbling up in my yard.

Long story short, if you like paying a ton for a sub par experience that takes over a week to get done.  This is your company!   If you like quality at a fair price done on a timely basis, move to the next result.

reviewsSample.author: Gia C
reviewsSample.text: We recently moved to Tyler, Texas, and quickly discovered that our septic system requires specialized expertise. We had no idea what we were facing, so we gave them a call. Alfonso was extremely helpful, answered my questions, and scheduled someone to come out the next day. The technician reviewed the entire system, explained everything clearly, told us what warning signs to look for and when to call, and replace the sprinkler heads. By the time he was finished, everything was working perfectly. Talk about peace of mind! The service exceeded my expectations, and I would not hesitate to call them again. They have definitely earned our future business!

reviewsSample.author: Tamela Callahan
reviewsSample.text: Alfonso and crew did a wonderful job replacing my 44-year-old traditional septic to an aerobic system. The property is a duplex and he was able to connect both sides so that I did not waste money on 2 different systems for each side. We ran into a little hiccup as the previous connections were odd and the wash machine lines were missed but Alfonso and crew returned to make the needed repairs. I was more than happy to have the septic system install vs having to connect to liberty utilities. Initially I was against the anerobic system, but once Alfonso taught me how to maintain it, now I am a pro. I am very happy with the 2-year warranty. Any questions I've had of Alfonso he was quick to respond. 10/10 would suggest.

reviewsSample.text: Set an appointment with them and even received a reminder call. The date of the appointment we received a call letting us know they were 10 minutes away from our home. reviewsSample.author: Stephen Dreger
reviewsSample.text: I called Levi to inquire about putting in a new system in Marietta. He came out quickly and after some quick soil testing, determined an aerobic systems was my best solution. I was able to schedule an install date in less than two weeks. He and Trent came out first thing in the morning at the time they specified and got straight to work. Both are very knowledgeable about their business. They are genuinely nice and attentive to the customer's needs. I had a couple small requests that they we very happy to take care of for me. I have a couple more systems to put in down the road and will definitely be calling Levi to do those jobs. Highly recommend LK Septic.

reviewsSample.author: Teresa Colpaert
reviewsSample.text: What a great experience it was to have Trent and Levi working with us to determine what type of septic was needed on our property. Trent was very knowledgeable and walked us through a few options, then when it time to get the job done they were on time, provided an explanation of the system and did a quality job!

reviewsSample.author: Danny Spruill
reviewsSample.text:
I highly recommend LK Septic Services.  Levi was my first point of contact when I called in with an issue with my drip septic system.  He was very knowledgeable and attentive to my concerns.  Within a few days,  he sent Kevin out to fix an issue with the timer and re-route the  return line.  Kevin was very knowledgeable and is an excellent employee. Will be using them again for any future issues with my septic system.
Danny Spruill

reviewsSample.author: Carla
reviewsSample.text: Just learned LK Septic partnered with my current company in Marshall,  for aerobic system maintenance and pump out, these guys are amazing! They are more thorough, and affordable than their competitors. These guys answer their phones, they show up when they say they are going to, they don't make you wait for weeks to schedule an appointment  or show up when they feel like it, and they do a very good job and clean up when they are done. LK Septic runs a tight ship they deliver on customer service, quality of work, and affordability in their service, I highly recommend!  Thank you LK Septic!

reviewsSample.author: Chris Deem
reviewsSample.text: I recently had the pleasure of working with LK Septic, and I couldn’t be more impressed. Levi's customer service was exceptional—friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive from start to finish. He took the time to explain the process and answer all my questions, which made the whole experience stress-free. On top of that, their prices were very competitive, offering great value without compromising on quality. I highly recommend LK for anyone in need of reliable and affordable septic services.

reviewsSample.text: The faucets to my washing machine needed replacing. They showed up on time. The guys were super pleasant, and the job was completed with no snags. He also recommended a man who salvages metal to come pick up my washer.

reviewsSample.text: James and Ocean Plumbing always does top quality work.  He permanently repairs any issues, never cuts corners so it stays fixed.  He is honest and reasonable.  I do not even hesitate, if I have any issue, I call Ocean Plumbing immediately.

reviewsSample.author: Bridget Bitter
reviewsSample.text: We have been in our house for 3 years.  We have had a couple different plumbers come out because of water pressure problems in the house.  Every time they told us, the pressure is fine.  James from Ocean Plumbing did some work for our neighbors and did an amazing job with fair pricing, so we had him come out.  He did more than just the basic test and found there was a problem at the city line.  He told us who to call and what to tell them.  The city came out and first said everything looked fine but then did another test and found that we were only getting 8 gallons per minute.  We should be getting at least 17.  The city replaced our piping that was outdated and clogged and we now get 25 gallons per minute.  We are so grateful to James and Ocean Plumbing for taking the extra steps to check out our issue and not just doing the basic test and taking our money. We will ONLY use Ocean Plumbing, along with every other neighbor on the street!

reviewsSample.author: Edgar Lewis
reviewsSample.text: Our water heater quit working, and the response was excellent. They gave us helpful plumbing advice over the phone at no charge, even on the weekend, and set up a service call very quickly. The estimate was free, and the repair work was scheduled and finished fast. Most importantly, the water heater job was done the right way and everything is working great. Tristan was friendly, professional, and respectful throughout the whole process. We also really appreciated that the final price came in lower than the estimate, which was a great surprise. In the Conroe heat, having hot water and reliable plumbing service handled this quickly meant a lot. I highly recommend them for water heater and plumbing work.

reviewsSample.author: Stanley Barron
reviewsSample.text: i highly recommend this plumbing company to anyone needing service. my most recent visit was for a water heater replacement, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. tristan and ruben did an excellent job replacing a low boy water heater. they arrived on time, were friendly, professional, knowledgeable, and thorough, and they handled the plumbing work with real skill and care. they answered all of my questions, explained my options clearly, and made sure everything was working properly before they left. the office support was also excellent. jeffery helped walk me through the process, including product choices, pricing, scheduling, and a detailed quote before the job was booked. communication was clear, patient, and professional the entire time. the work was completed efficiently, done right, and priced fairly. it is hard to find a trustworthy plumbing service, but this team truly earned my confidence, and i would gladly recommend them again.

reviewsSample.author: keith fischer
reviewsSample.text: When we had an after-hours plumbing emergency at our home, a clogged main drain line, the response was quick and very helpful. Craig arrived that evening with Jeffery and came in with a calm, friendly attitude. They took time to ask smart questions about the plumbing symptoms, the bathroom and drain layout, and what we were seeing before starting any work. Instead of guessing, Craig asked to see all of the cleanouts and carefully checked the system step by step. They worked through the troubleshooting process, stayed patient, and figured out the source of the blockage even though the plumbing setup in this older home is a little tricky. I appreciated that they did not rush to conclusions and handled the job with real skill and care. I have used this plumbing company for many smaller plumbing repairs over the years, and they have always treated me fairly and with respect. The work has consistently been solid, and I have never needed to call anyone back to redo a repair. That kind of reliability means a lot when dealing with drains, sewer line issues, and unexpected plumbing problems. One of the biggest things worth mentioning is how hard it usually is to get anyone to respond quickly after hours, especially when it feels urgent for your family. This team showed up fast, communicated clearly, and solved the problem with professionalism, honesty, and empathy. I am very thankful they were there when we needed emergency plumbing help most.

reviewsSample.author: Judith Wilkerson
reviewsSample.text: I can’t say enough good things about Erickson Brothers Water Heaters. Micah, Craig, Jeffery, and Micah provided outstanding customer service and made the whole plumbing and water heater process easy from start to finish. Years ago, during a remodel in Conroe, I bought all the plumbing fixtures for the project through them, and everything came together smoothly. The faucets, connections, and fixture setup all worked great, and the install support was excellent. Now, after all this time, the customer care is still just as strong. Micah is highly knowledgeable about plumbing fixtures, sizing, layouts, and installation details, and always gives clear, trustworthy advice. Jeffery is incredibly helpful, responsive, and willing to go the extra mile to make sure every part of the job is handled right. Craig is a skilled plumber who remembers project details, understands the work thoroughly, and delivers top-level service with real professionalism. Micah was not heavily involved in every step, but was always ready to help when needed and made sure we felt supported. It is rare to find a plumbing company that offers such dependable service, strong follow-through, and personal attention. Even after moving within Conroe for another remodel, I was very happy they were able to help again. If you need help with plumbing fixtures, water heater service, or remodel plumbing work, this is a team you can trust.

reviewsSample.author: Peter Yoder
reviewsSample.text: Micah arrived right on time, just as Erickson Brothers Water Heaters said he would. What started as one toilet problem turned into a bigger plumbing service visit after my husband and i explained the other issues we had with three more toilets in the house. Micah carefully checked each toilet, listened to our concerns, and explained several simple repair options for every problem. After we talked it through, my husband and i chose the best plan, and he put together a clear and fair service estimate for the toilet repairs and replacement work. As he moved through the plumbing steps, he kept us updated on what he was doing, which made the whole process easy to understand. Another plumber arrived with the needed parts and helped remove the old toilets that were being replaced. We found Micah to be efficient, skilled, and very easy to work with from start to finish. He handled the toilet issues with care, explained the plumbing work in plain language, and made sure everything stayed on track. This was our first visit with micah, and we were very pleased with the professional service, good communication, and solid workmanship. It is great to expect quality plumbing work and actually receive it.

reviewsSample.author: Andrew Dimitra
reviewsSample.text: Honest guy treats everybody respect don’t charge an arm and a leg reasonable price shows up on time gets everything done all around. Had a great time with this company. I will recommend for anybody that needs their septic system pumped out. Give him a holler respectable guy.

reviewsSample.author: Darrell Barnes
reviewsSample.text: Couldn't be more satisfied with the level of service. I called because our tanks were full and needed someone to pump them out. Shay was honest and let me know when he could reasonably make it out and kept to his word. He even provided the quote for the service over the phone so I knew what to expect. If you need your septic serviced, call these guys. He even made recommendations to prolong the time between him having to come out and pump again. Thanks so much for the excellent customer service.

reviewsSample.author: Ruth Rasmussen
reviewsSample.text: Used another company for over 20 years but now they've raised their prices to dig up access to septic tanks. Found DL3 online and they're over $100 lower.  Jordon came out & only charged to dig up 1 of our 3 tanks. All 3 tanks pumped quickly. Talked to Dan/Dave? several times who sent me info when we were still having trouble.  After telling us we needed a new system, he recommended a plumber who could connect us to city sewer several feet away. They spent so much time answering questions, explaining our system and listening to our concerns.  Way above and beyond.  Best in N. TX.

reviewsSample.author: DL
reviewsSample.text: Great Company. Jordan spent time to help me find my tanks. One was buried under my walkway so he and Dan advised me on the best options for access. They came out same day each time I needed them and the price was very fair.  I called 2 other companies that never replied and I'm glad they didn't. These guys are great.  Use them with confidence.

reviewsSample.author: Bernie Brown
reviewsSample.text: Unfortunately, I don't remember the name of the gentleman that helped us out today.  Signature looks like Jordan.  But, what I will never forget is the very courteous and speedy service.  I'd spent a few hours uncovering one of the tanks, waiting over 10 days for another company (their trucks were both in the shop, not their fault), and was getting worried about putting my deck back together so it would be safe for my family and grandkids to make the trek over to the pool.  The other company had agreed to find a "partner" to assist due to the long period of time we'd gone since the sewer first backed up (Memorial Day weekend).  I got a phone call at 9:22 am. By 11:00 am, the work was complete.  He uncovered the second tank, had both tanks pumped, and was ready to go in less than an hour and a half.  Fantastic service.  Could not ask for better.  I will be calling DL3 first if I have problems in the future.  Always go local. Always go with a small business.  It's important.

reviewsSample.author: Adam Erickson
reviewsSample.text: Excellent service - had a backup and didn't know what was causing it. They sent a camera through to take a look and we were fortunate that it was a 'soft blockage' that could be cleared by routing of the camera. The view of the line was good to see so that we could have confidence in what caused it. We learned that the wyes that were plumbed in for future basement fixtures can cause these blockages if there isn't water periodically run through them to clear them. When the basement get's completed and water is running through those lines, we shouldn't have problems, but it was good to know the cause and what to expect moving forward.

reviewsSample.author: Brook Bernier 801.604.1895
reviewsSample.text: Been using Drain Champ since 2012. Dan is an expert at clearing drains, and scoping sewer lines. His pricing is affordable, he's honest and appointments are easy to make, he can often come on short notice. Several years ago, I was selling a home, the plumbing outfit the buyers first hired sent us a bogus video of the sewer line, at a cost of over $20k to replace. I had a off feeling about them, so I immediately called Drain Champ. Dan came out, we watched the view of the sewer line as he scoped it and there was nothing wrong with the sewer line. The previous company was a huge scam. Dan saved this deal and my buyers have been happily raising their family in this home and are still so grateful to him, his expertise and honesty. He's my #1 choice for any drain and scope needs!!

reviewsSample.author: Paul Manley

reviewsSample.author: Eddie Shaffer
reviewsSample.text: We called Gross Family Plumbing Llc about an annoying drain backup affecting our whole house in Salt Lake City, and we were glad to get same day service. miguel arrived right on time and worked hard to make sure the clog and drainage issue were fully cleared. he worked fast, was very thorough with testing and retesting the flow, and checked that everything was draining the way it should before finishing. he was very respectful, explained the plumbing work in simple terms, and left the area clean with no mess behind. our bill was very reasonable, and we will definitely use them again for future plumbing service because the whole experience was smooth, professional, and handled really well.

reviewsSample.author: marissa peck
reviewsSample.text: Gross Family Plumbing LLC did stellar work for us on several plumbing projects in Salt Lake City. Miguel came back for more work and once again made a tough kitchen sink relocation look easy, even though it required opening part of the foundation to move the drain and water lines. I feel very confident the plumbing work is high quality and built to last. After dealing with other plumbers who had poor workmanship and missed appointments, Billy really listened, understood the urgency, and took the time to look over the job carefully. When the work started, Miguel fixed the plumbing issues that had been left behind and clearly explained what to watch for during the rest of the bathroom and kitchen work. That guidance helped a lot and made the whole process much smoother. Later, Miguel and Billy came back to finish the installation of the toilet, tub, shower, and sink faucets. Everything was completed in a timely way, the plumbing fixtures were installed neatly, and the work area was left very clean. The office staff was also courteous, knowledgeable, and patient throughout the scheduling and follow-up. I highly recommend them for quality plumbing work, good communication, and professional service.

reviewsSample.author: Raymond F
reviewsSample.text: I don’t usually post reviews, but Gross Family Plumbing LLC really impressed me. Billy and Miguel were excellent from start to finish. Billy gave me a very fair quote to repair my broken shower, and it came in a couple hundred dollars lower than the first estimate I got from another plumber. On the day of the job, they arrived on time, worked efficiently, and handled the shower repair with real skill and care. The work was finished faster than I expected, and the final bill was almost $300 less than the original estimate, which was a great surprise. They were professional, honest, and easy to work with, and they made the whole plumbing repair process smooth and stress-free. It is not always easy to find a reliable plumber in Salt Lake City, so I really appreciated their clear pricing, solid workmanship, and respectful service. I would gladly recommend them to anyone needing shower or household plumbing help.

reviewsSample.author: S Sheppard
reviewsSample.text: We contacted Gross Family Plumbing LLC to replace our old tank water heater with a tankless hot water heater, and the whole plumbing process went very smoothly. miguel came out first, checked our setup carefully, explained the options in simple terms, and even looked in the attic to make sure the existing water lines and venting would work well for the new unit. The quote came back lower than the other plumbing estimates we had received, which made the decision much easier. We were able to get the installation scheduled quickly because they had an opening, and that was a big help. On install day, billy and miguel worked fast and efficiently. From draining the old tank to finishing the final connections and putting the cover on the new unit, the job moved along nicely and looked very organized. They kept the work area clean, were respectful in our home, and made the whole water heater replacement feel stress free. Everything looks professionally done, and the new system is working great with strong hot water and better space savings. i really appreciated that all of our questions were answered clearly, and we never felt rushed. they also made it clear that if anything comes up later, we can call with questions. overall, this was a great experience, and we would definitely use them again for any plumbing needs in Salt Lake City.

reviewsSample.author: Reagan Nixon
reviewsSample.text: Great experience with Gross Family Plumbing LLC. Miguel was fast and thorough with the estimate and explained in simple terms what would work best for my plumbing setup. Billy and the crew did an excellent job installing my new water heater and updating the plumbing connections and related components. I work from home, and they kept interruptions to a minimum during the whole job. They were organized, professional, and made the full plumbing upgrade feel smooth and easy. I would definitely recommend them for water heater installation and plumbing work.

reviewsSample.author: Andra Stowe
reviewsSample.text: We had a late Friday afternoon sewage backup into our basement and I knew that it was because we had never had our septic tank cleaned out. Shane happened to be nearby and came over within 15 minutes!  We had no clue where our cover was, so after attempting to help us find it, he said “here is my cell phone number. I promise I’ll come right back once you find it. And true to his word, he did!  The cost was much less then I had anticipated (especially with a weekend emergency) and when I told him how long we had lived in our house, and that we hadn’t had it pumped EVER, he was super nice about it. THIS is great customer service. No making me feel worse than I already did. No price gouging just because he knew it was an emergency. Just old fashioned customer service with a smile. Thank you Lakeshore for being there for us!!!

reviewsSample.author: Melany Fausto
reviewsSample.text: Definitely the worst company I have ever hired. Dude wasn’t there for long told me he couldn’t find the septic tank lid. Charge me and left. Took me two minutes to find the lid I couldn’t give O stars 🤦🏻‍♀️ …

I’m extremely happy with the results and would recommend Pipe Rehab Specialist Sewer Repair to anyone who wants reliable work, honest pricing, and a team that truly cares about doing the job right.

I’ve already recommended them to a friend of a friend who needs her sewer lined, and I’ll recommend them to anyone else who asks!
